chapters.title: Chapter 122: The Final Battle II
paragraphs: A strong wind was blowing across the entire arena.
The deep cracks that had been created by the previous clashes covered the entire battlefield like huge wounds.
At the center of this destruction, Lian and Seris stood several meters away from each other, for several minutes, they had fought without using their main skills.
Only with experience, only with raw power, so they could see how close they were to each other in terms of stats, and the result surprised both of them.
Their stats were far too close to each other, so close that neither of them could gain the advantage by using only raw power.
The mana around Lian suddenly exploded, purple lightning ran through his body, hundreds of sparks appeared in the air.
The sound of thunder echoed across the arena like the roar of a monster.
[ Thunder Calamity ]
Lightning covered his entire body, his muscles tightened, it was finally time to use this skill with its full power.
With the same amount of power that had been shown inside the simulator.
But at that exact moment... Seris also moved, she was not going to simply watch either, and she slightly raised her silver sword.
And finally, in this tournament, she used one of her skills.
[ King’s Breaker ]
No blinding light appeared, no huge explosion happened, but those who had a high understanding of mana immediately noticed the change.

Something around the sword blade had changed, it was as if the very concept of "defense" had become weaker against it, and that was when they understood that this was a skill that could ignore defense.
BOOM!
The first clash happened, Lian’s fist and Seris’ sword collided in the air, and a huge shockwave spread everywhere.
BOOM!
The second clash.
BOOM!
The third clash.
Seris attacked more accurately every time, and suddenly... a very faint sound could be heard.
Crack.
Lian frowned, a noticeable wound appeared on his arm, his opponent’s attack had managed to injure him!
After Cassius, now Seris had also managed to break through his Diamond Skin defense and directly hurt him.
"At this rate, this skill won’t be very useful in the future, I need to find a better one." he muttered.
Diamond Skin was already a Divine Rank skill, it had to be powerful, and it was, but he realized it was not absolute against geniuses like Seris, and that was dangerous.
He needed that defense against powerful enemies like this girl, not against a few useless normal monsters that he could kill with one punch.
But this was not the time for that, and Lian’s attention was somewhere else, he was analyzing.
This was how he always fought, he always analyzed his opponents during battle, at least the ones he could not defeat with only raw strength and had to use his mind as well.
His fist and her sword clashed once again.
"Her speed is lower than mine."
The next clash.
"But the timing of her attacks is better."
The third clash.
The sword passed beside his face.
"It’s not just the timing." He started examining every movement Seris made.
Her steps, her breathing, the movement of her wrist, the movement of her shoulders, even the way she shifted the center of her body, and little by little he realized a strange truth.
There was not a single unnecessary movement, none at all, not even one centimeter, not even one millimeter, every movement Seris made was perfectly optimized.
Every step, every strike, every turn was done in the most perfect way possible.
It was as if she had practiced each one of them thousands of times until they became perfect.
’I am willing to bet she spends all day training.’ He admired this girl, and he had to admire her.
Seris’ silver eyes shined and then...
[ Silver Requiem ]
Her sword disappeared.
Or at least that was how it looked to the eyes of most of the spectators.
In one moment, just one moment... dozens of sword marks appeared on the ground, and long cracks covered the entire arena.
The spectators had only seen one movement, but the result showed something completely different.
Dozens of slashes, dozens of attacks, dozens of different angles, all within a fraction of a second, and dozens of places on Lian’s body were cut open, blood started spraying everywhere.
His defense had been completely broken.
"Damn it." Lian was forced to use another skill and increase the power of his attacks.
[ Glacial Reaper Claw ]
The air inside the arena suddenly froze, and a huge claw of ice formed around his hand.
The lightning of Thunder Calamity flowed through the ice crystals, lightning and ice mixed together.
BOOOOOOM!
A huge collision happened, the ice exploded, and lightning spread through the air.
Seris’ defense was finally broken as well, her right shoulder was injured, and blood flowed down from that area.
Seris looked at her shoulder and frowned for a moment, injuring her right shoulder could affect her performance.
She had landed dozens of attacks, but none of them had affected her opponent’s overall performance, but only one attack from her enemy had targeted her performance and caused much greater damage.
Lian took a deep breath, he had managed to land one important hit, and started calculating again.
"This doesn’t make sense, it really doesn’t make sense, even if she has a five-star class..."
Numbers appeared in his mind, Seris should be at most Level 15, and even if she really had a five-star class, she should have gained at most around three hundred stats from leveling up.
How is she this strong?
"Of course... the Pendragon family’s resources."
The answer was simple.
The Pendragon family’s resources, he immediately reached that conclusion.
This girl had access to resources that most people could not even imagine.
Permanent medicines, treasures that increased stats, items, everything that a family at the level of the Pendragons could provide.
Besides that, an Awakened with a five-star class could gain at most two thousand stat points before the first evolution.
Lian himself currently had more than one thousand stats, and this girl definitely had the same.
But there was one difference between the two of them, he had gained this amount in one month, while Seris had gained this amount of power during the last two years.

But even that alone did not explain why this girl was so powerful, because his brother was also Level 15, and his stats were not that much lower than hers, they were definitely lower, but the gap was not that huge.
But besides her stats, this girl also had terrifying swordsmanship.
Seris attacked once again, and this time...
[ King’s Edge ] was activated.
At first no one noticed, but Lian felt it immediately, every sword strike became heavier than the previous one, every attack became more accurate than before, and every clash became more dangerous.
It was as if Seris’ swordsmanship itself was becoming more perfect every moment.
And little by little... the advantage started moving toward her.
More wounds appeared on Lian’s body.
On his arm, on his shoulder, on his cheek, and unlike before, the wounds were no longer random, every single one targeted an important spot.
The spectators felt that maybe Lian was truly under pressure... and maybe they were finally going to witness this boy’s defeat.
Lian jumped back and frowned, if he allowed this to continue, the situation would only become worse.
So...
[ Cataclysm Pulse ]
Mana became dense throughout the entire arena, the air shook, the ground collapsed, hundreds of new cracks appeared across the arena.
Then... the explosion.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!
A wave of destruction covered the entire arena, the protective walls cracked, and some of the stadium’s defensive barriers flickered for a moment.
Even the elders frowned from the pressure.
Seris was pushed backward, and she felt that the explosion had injured her bones.
"Cough, cough." She unconsciously coughed up a few drops of blood.
Seris’ silver eyes shined with excitement, she was not angry, instead, her blood was boiling from excitement.
She was finally experiencing a real battle! A battle she could truly enjoy.
’If this keeps going, I might become addicted to fighting him.’ She thought to herself, and came to the conclusion that maybe it was better to end this battle.
Seris quietly whispered.
[ Sovereign’s Judgment. ]
No huge explosion happened, no blinding light appeared, no wave of mana appeared, but suddenly... Lian stopped.
He completely stopped... his body would no longer move, it was as if time had stopped only for him.
His mana would not respond, his muscles would not obey him, everything had stopped.
He knew this skill, it was the skill Seris had used against Deadmaw, the skill that had managed to stop even an Unholy for one full second.
If it could stop an Unholy for one second... then for how many seconds could it stop him?
At the same time, he realized that this was a soul attack skill.
Seris raised her sword, and her third offensive skill was activated.
[ Heavenfall Execution ]
A dazzling silver light covered the entire blade, the mana pressure increased several times, the ground beneath her feet cracked, even the air itself started shaking.
"Does that girl intend to kill him...?" That thought appeared in everyone’s mind.
Lian still could not move, Seris appeared only a few meters away from him, and her silver sword was falling.
The pressure coming from that attack was terrifying even before it landed.
Every spectator held their breath.
And at that exact moment... a small smile appeared on Lian’s face.
A calm smile, a smile that looked as if he had understood something... and that... was the biggest reason to be afraid.
Because no one knew why someone who was standing on the edge of defeat... would suddenly smile.

sentences.text: A strong wind was blowing across the entire arena.
The deep cracks that had been created by the previous clashes covered the entire battlefield like huge wounds.
At the center of this destruction, Lian and Seris stood several meters away from each other, for several minutes, they had fought without using their main skills.
Only with experience, only with raw power, so they could see how close they were to each other in terms of stats, and the result surprised both of them.
Their stats were far too close to each other, so close that neither of them could gain the advantage by using only raw power.
The mana around Lian suddenly exploded, purple lightning ran through his body, hundreds of sparks appeared in the air.
The sound of thunder echoed across the arena like the roar of a monster.
[ Thunder Calamity ]
Lightning covered his entire body, his muscles tightened, it was finally time to use this skill with its full power.
With the same amount of power that had been shown inside the simulator.
But at that exact moment...
Seris also moved, she was not going to simply watch either, and she slightly raised her silver sword.
And finally, in this tournament, she used one of her skills.
[ King’s Breaker ]
No blinding light appeared, no huge explosion happened, but those who had a high understanding of mana immediately noticed the change.

Something around the sword blade had changed, it was as if the very concept of "defense" had become weaker against it, and that was when they understood that this was a skill that could ignore defense.
BOOM!
The first clash happened, Lian’s fist and Seris’ sword collided in the air, and a huge shockwave spread everywhere.
BOOM!
The second clash.
BOOM!
The third clash.
Seris attacked more accurately every time, and suddenly... a very faint sound could be heard.
Crack.
Lian frowned, a noticeable wound appeared on his arm, his opponent’s attack had managed to injure him!
After Cassius, now Seris had also managed to break through his Diamond Skin defense and directly hurt him.
"At this rate, this skill won’t be very useful in the future, I need to find a better one." he muttered.
Diamond Skin was already a Divine Rank skill, it had to be powerful, and it was, but he realized it was not absolute against geniuses like Seris, and that was dangerous.
He needed that defense against powerful enemies like this girl, not against a few useless normal monsters that he could kill with one punch.
But this was not the time for that, and Lian’s attention was somewhere else, he was analyzing.
This was how he always fought, he always analyzed his opponents during battle, at least the ones he could not defeat with only raw strength and had to use his mind as well.
His fist and her sword clashed once again.
"Her speed is lower than mine."
The next clash.
"But the timing of her attacks is better."
The third clash.
The sword passed beside his face.
"It’s not just the timing." He started examining every movement Seris made.
Her steps, her breathing, the movement of her wrist, the movement of her shoulders, even the way she shifted the center of her body, and little by little he realized a strange truth.
There was not a single unnecessary movement, none at all, not even one centimeter, not even one millimeter, every movement Seris made was perfectly optimized.
Every step, every strike, every turn was done in the most perfect way possible.
It was as if she had practiced each one of them thousands of times until they became perfect.
’I am willing to bet she spends all day training.’ He admired this girl, and he had to admire her.
Seris’ silver eyes shined and then...
[ Silver Requiem ]
Her sword disappeared.
Or at least that was how it looked to the eyes of most of the spectators.
In one moment, just one moment... dozens of sword marks appeared on the ground, and long cracks covered the entire arena.
The spectators had only seen one movement, but the result showed something completely different.
Dozens of slashes, dozens of attacks, dozens of different angles, all within a fraction of a second, and dozens of places on Lian’s body were cut open, blood started spraying everywhere.
His defense had been completely broken.
"Damn it." Lian was forced to use another skill and increase the power of his attacks.
[ Glacial Reaper Claw ]
The air inside the arena suddenly froze, and a huge claw of ice formed around his hand.
The lightning of Thunder Calamity flowed through the ice crystals, lightning and ice mixed together.
BOOOOOOM!
A huge collision happened, the ice exploded, and lightning spread through the air.
Seris’ defense was finally broken as well, her right shoulder was injured, and blood flowed down from that area.
Seris looked at her shoulder and frowned for a moment, injuring her right shoulder could affect her performance.
She had landed dozens of attacks, but none of them had affected her opponent’s overall performance, but only one attack from her enemy had targeted her performance and caused much greater damage.
Lian took a deep breath, he had managed to land one important hit, and started calculating again.
"This doesn’t make sense, it really doesn’t make sense, even if she has a five-star class..."
Numbers appeared in his mind, Seris should be at most Level 15, and even if she really had a five-star class, she should have gained at most around three hundred stats from leveling up.
How is she this strong?
"Of course... the Pendragon family’s resources."
The answer was simple.
The Pendragon family’s resources, he immediately reached that conclusion.
This girl had access to resources that most people could not even imagine.
Permanent medicines, treasures that increased stats, items, everything that a family at the level of the Pendragons could provide.
Besides that, an Awakened with a five-star class could gain at most two thousand stat points before the first evolution.
Lian himself currently had more than one thousand stats, and this girl definitely had the same.
But there was one difference between the two of them, he had gained this amount in one month, while Seris had gained this amount of power during the last two years.

But even that alone did not explain why this girl was so powerful, because his brother was also Level 15, and his stats were not that much lower than hers, they were definitely lower, but the gap was not that huge.
But besides her stats, this girl also had terrifying swordsmanship.
Seris attacked once again, and this time...
[ King’s Edge ] was activated.
At first no one noticed, but Lian felt it immediately, every sword strike became heavier than the previous one, every attack became more accurate than before, and every clash became more dangerous.
It was as if Seris’ swordsmanship itself was becoming more perfect every moment.
And little by little... the advantage started moving toward her.
More wounds appeared on Lian’s body.
On his arm, on his shoulder, on his cheek, and unlike before, the wounds were no longer random, every single one targeted an important spot.
The spectators felt that maybe Lian was truly under pressure... and maybe they were finally going to witness this boy’s defeat.
Lian jumped back and frowned, if he allowed this to continue, the situation would only become worse.
So...
[ Cataclysm Pulse ]
Mana became dense throughout the entire arena, the air shook, the ground collapsed, hundreds of new cracks appeared across the arena.
Then... the explosion.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!
A wave of destruction covered the entire arena, the protective walls cracked, and some of the stadium’s defensive barriers flickered for a moment.
Even the elders frowned from the pressure.
Seris was pushed backward, and she felt that the explosion had injured her bones.
"Cough, cough." She unconsciously coughed up a few drops of blood.
Seris’ silver eyes shined with excitement, she was not angry, instead, her blood was boiling from excitement.
She was finally experiencing a real battle!
A battle she could truly enjoy.
’If this keeps going, I might become addicted to fighting him.’ She thought to herself, and came to the conclusion that maybe it was better to end this battle.
Seris quietly whispered.
[ Sovereign’s Judgment. ]
No huge explosion happened, no blinding light appeared, no wave of mana appeared, but suddenly...
Lian stopped.
He completely stopped... his body would no longer move, it was as if time had stopped only for him.
His mana would not respond, his muscles would not obey him, everything had stopped.
He knew this skill, it was the skill Seris had used against Deadmaw, the skill that had managed to stop even an Unholy for one full second.
If it could stop an Unholy for one second... then for how many seconds could it stop him?
At the same time, he realized that this was a soul attack skill.
Seris raised her sword, and her third offensive skill was activated.
[ Heavenfall Execution ]
A dazzling silver light covered the entire blade, the mana pressure increased several times, the ground beneath her feet cracked, even the air itself started shaking.
"Does that girl intend to kill him...?" That thought appeared in everyone’s mind.
Lian still could not move, Seris appeared only a few meters away from him, and her silver sword was falling.
The pressure coming from that attack was terrifying even before it landed.
Every spectator held their breath.
And at that exact moment... a small smile appeared on Lian’s face.
A calm smile, a smile that looked as if he had understood something... and that... was the biggest reason to be afraid.
Because no one knew why someone who was standing on the edge of defeat... would suddenly smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 123: The Final Battle III
paragraphs: Seris’s silver sword was coming down.
The bright light of Heavenfall Execution covered the entire arena, and even many of the spectators were already sure about the result of this battle.
From everyone’s point of view, Lian had definitely lost and Seris was the winner of this duel...
But Lian was no longer looking at the sword, he was thinking about something much more important.
The problem was not his muscles, the problem was not his speed, it was not even his mana, the problem was his soul, his whole body was screaming at him to move.
But something invisible was keeping him in place.
[ Sovereign’s Judgment ]
A soul attack skill, an absolute command, a direct suppression of the will.
Lian had felt that he had lost control of his body, but in reality it was his soul and mind that were no longer listening to him.
And in those few short moments, the blue panel appeared in front of his eyes.
[ Stats Points: 28 ]
There was no doubt, there was no need to think, all twenty-eight points went directly into Spirit.
At that moment, something inside him broke, of course it was not a bone, but an invisible chain that had trapped him.
He felt as if a huge wall inside his mind had collapsed, the spiritual pressure that had seemed impossible to endure just a moment ago suddenly cracked.
Like breaking the lock of a prison, like the chains of a prisoner being shattered.
And he managed to free himself from that skill, he managed to take back control of his body.
Heavenfall Execution came down.
The silver light split the ground like a heavenly lightning bolt, but at the very last moment, Lian’s body moved.
Not completely, not enough, but it moved, the sword passed beside his body, its edge cut through his left shoulder and his side.
Blood burst out and his body was dragged several meters across the ground.
The terrified voices of the spectators echoed through the stadium, many believed it was over.
And everyone looked at the girl in disbelief, did she really want to kill her opponent? Why? Did they have some kind of hatred between them?
Everyone was sure this was the end of the battle, but when the dust slowly cleared, they saw Lian still standing.
And on his face... there was a smile, drops of blood were falling onto the ground.
The wound was deep, the pain was intense, but at that very moment something activated.
[ Blood Rush ]
His blood started boiling inside his veins, his heart began beating harder, and every wound on his body made him stronger instead of weaker.
Faster, more dangerous and more deadly.
"You’re still alive?" Seris had to take one step back, even she did not seem to expect that her opponent had survived.
"Did you really try to kill me?" Lian looked at her with a blank expression, he had never expected this girl to attack him with the intention of killing him.
"Of course not, I was sure you could free yourself."
"You were sure? I kind of doubt that."
Seris paused for a moment and did not answer immediately, as if she was looking for an excuse, then she added.
"I got a little too excited and completely forgot that this was a friendly match."
Lian said nothing, he only became sure that his guess was correct, this girl was truly crazy! A crazy person who forgot everything once she became absorbed in a battle!
He sighed and they started attacking again.
Until this moment, Seris had the advantage.
But something had changed.
Every minute that passed, Lian became stronger.
On the other hand, for the first time, Seris had started using a real amount of energy, her breathing was still steady, but it was no longer perfect.
Her movements were still precise, but they were no longer perfect.
More than twenty minutes had passed while both of them fought with everything they had, Seris had even used some of her strongest skills many times.
Her energy was slowly running out.
Lian could see these small changes, and the hunter inside him had awakened, because of [ Blood Rush ] he had no lack of stamina or energy.
His only problem was that his mana reserves were slowly running out.
The clashes between his fists covered in ice and lightning against the sword continued.
The battlefield had become a hell of energy, but Lian’s mind was still analyzing.
"Her speed is still amazing."
Clash.
"But she’s a little slower than before."
Another clash.
"Her reaction time has dropped."
Seris’s sword passed beside his face and he dodged.
He blocked the next strike.
"After all, she’s not unbeatable, and that’s her weakness."
Lian realized something, Seris was not perfect, she had only spent her whole life trying to get as close to perfection as possible.
But she was still human, and humans get tired.
The smile on Lian’s face became deeper.
"I got you." This girl’s defense had reached its lowest point because her energy was running out.
But he himself was becoming stronger and stronger with every passing moment, and now the time had finally come.
At that moment, he raised his hand, the mana around him went completely wild.
The ground beneath his feet cracked, and for the second time...
[ Cataclysm Pulse ]
This time, the goal was not to destroy the battlefield, the goal was to break Seris’s rhythm.
The massive explosion shook the entire battlefield, the shockwave spread outward like an invisible storm.
The ground collapsed, rocks shattered, the protective walls trembled.
And Seris was pushed back, not because of the power, and at that moment she lost her balance.
Only for a fraction of a second, but that was enough for Lian.
The panel appeared again.
[ Do you want to upgrade Blood Rush? ]
[ 15 Fragments Required ]
Without any hesitation, he pressed Yes.
[ Confirm ]
Mana exploded throughout his entire body.
[ Warrior’s Madness ]
[ Rank: Great ]
[ Description: The more damage you take, the more your strength, speed, reaction, resistance and recovery increase.
Thirty percent of the pain is suppressed and directly converted into energy, Resistance consumption is reduced, wound recovery is increased.
The effects of the skill grow exponentially, as long as mana remains, there will almost be no drop in performance.

The more wounds and damage you receive, the greater your madness becomes, the crazier you become, the stronger your punches become, until you become like a monster that cares about nothing except fighting.
Warning! It may affect decision-making!
Consumes 1 mana every minute. ]
Lian’s eyes widened and joy filled them, the upgrade was much better than he had expected.
Now both of them were in danger, Seris was exhausted, Lian was badly wounded, but unlike her... Lian’s strength was still increasing.
The next clash became even stronger.
And the next.
And the next.
Every strike shook the battlefield, every collision released another wave of energy.
But Seris realized that she had lost the initiative, she realized that she was being pushed back, and she realized that she was losing.
The final exchange began.
[ Thunder Calamity ]
[ Glacial Reaper Claw ]
At the same time, on the other side...
[ King’s Breaker ]
[ King’s Edge ]
[ Heavenfall Execution ]
The two monsters attacked for the last time, both of them knew they could not continue any longer, and this battle had to end now.
The final clash... light swallowed the entire battlefield.
The sword and the claw met at the center of the arena, and the explosion shook the entire stadium once again.
Then... silence finally covered everything.
Only dust, only smoke, and only destruction could be seen, the battle between the two eighteen-year-old Awakened looked like the end of the world.
If someone did not know they were both eighteen years old, they would never be able to guess it.
Everyone was standing, no one was breathing, no one was speaking, everyone was only waiting for the result.
The dust slowly cleared away, and finally the battlefield became visible.
Seris was kneeling on one knee, her silver sword was still in her hand, but she could no longer stand up.
Several meters away from her... Lian was still standing.
Blood was flowing from his body.
Half of his body had been destroyed, although it was slowly recovering and healing.
His hands were trembling, his mana was almost gone.
But... he was still standing.
The referee could only stare for a few seconds, as if he himself could not believe it, then he said with a trembling voice.
"Winner... Lian Vorhelm."

chapters.title: Chapter 124: The Champions
paragraphs: The battle was over, but no one was getting up from their place.

Thousands of people were staring at the field in silence, at the boy who was not even supposed to reach the second round, at the boy who was supposed to be a sacrifice for the political games of the clan.
At the boy who was supposed to join history as a loser.
But now... he was the only person standing in the center of the field, and the champion of this tournament.
A gentle wind passed over the destroyed ground, blood could still be seen on Lian’s clothes.

His body was full of wounds, but he was still standing, and that was enough, that was enough for him to become the first place of this tournament, someone that no one expected to even make it into the top ten.
And the result? He became the first place! And with no cheating, only with pure power.
For the first few minutes, almost no one spoke, not even a whisper could be heard, as if everyone’s brains were still processing the events they had seen today.
In the special section of the Vorhelm clan, Celestia sat motionless, her appearance still seemed calm, but only she knew what storm was raging inside her.
All her plans were passing through her mind one after another.
Darius... Adrian... Cassius and even Seris.
Every stage of this tournament had been carefully designed, every obstacle, every choice, every scheme, everything was supposed to lead to one result.
Lian’s defeat.
But the final result was exactly the opposite, every person who was supposed to stop him had been defeated.
Everyone who had bet on him had fallen, and now the same boy who was supposed to be eliminated from the scene... was standing on the highest point.
Celestia unconsciously clenched her fists, her nails digging into the skin of her palms, she felt something inside her chest breaking.
Rage, humiliation, fear, and more than all of that... the feeling of losing control.
She had spent her whole life controlling situations, but now everything was out of her hands.
Worse than that... the whole stadium had seen this defeat.
All the nobles, all the clans, all their allies and enemies, everyone had witnessed her plans being destroyed.
At that moment, if someone looked into her eyes, they could see that behind that artificial calmness, something like madness was forming.
This was a defeat that was going to cost her a very heavy price.
She stared at Lian with madness in her eyes... she would never forget this humiliation and defeat, and she would definitely return it to him a thousand times over one day.
In another part of the section, the elders of the Vorhelm clan had gathered together.
No one was smiling, no one was happy, and the atmosphere was heavier than ever.
"How is that possible?" one of the elders said in a low voice.
Another did not take his gaze off the field.
"I don’t know."
"But it happened."
Another older man sighed.
"We had three contenders."
Everyone knew what he meant.
Cassius.
Evangeline.
Adrian.
Lucas.
Of course, Aron and Eliza were also there, but they had no chance of winning.
Three geniuses of the new generation, three people who were supposed to protect the clan’s reputation.

But none of them had succeeded, none of them! The only one from their clan who could make it into the top three ranks and become the first place... the only person who had the Vorhelm family name and had taken the quota...
Was Lian.
The boy who had been cast out years ago, this truth was more painful than the defeat itself, of course, there was also another truth.
Cassius and Evangeline were not the only geniuses of the clan, Diana was still growing, her talent was greater than many of the youths present.
The patriarch’s two other children had not participated in this competition at all, one of them even had a five-star class.
If they had been present, maybe the result would have been different, but these were only ifs, reality did not change.
The reality was that Lian today had defeated everyone who stood against him.
With power and with decisiveness, and without giving anyone a chance to deny it.
"We can no longer ignore him," one of the elders whispered quietly.
Another shook his head.
"No, the question is not whether he comes back or not, the question is how we bring him back."
A heavy silence fell among them, everyone knew what they were thinking about.
Old grudges or the future of the clan, they could not have both.
In the section of the foreign guests, the atmosphere was completely different.
Hidden smiles, meaningful looks, and whispers that were twisting like poison in the ears of the Vorhelm elders.
"Interesting."
The man next to him laughed.
"Really interesting."
"In the end, the only representative of the Vorhelm clan..." he paused and then continued,
"was the very one they themselves had kicked out."
A few others laughed quietly, a short laugh, but it was enough, every word was like a dagger sinking into the hearts of the Vorhelms.
It was not that they had a grudge against the Vorhelm clan, but this was something that could not be denied.
All across the stadium, only one name was being heard.
Lian.
"What is his class really? How many stars?"
"Four stars?"
"No... unlikely."
"I have never seen such a thing from a four-star."
"So five stars?"
"Even five stars does not explain everything."
"What were those skills?
"Lightning."
"Ice."
"Physical body."
"That strange blood skill."
"Where did all this power come from?"
Every group had an opinion, some were talking about innate skills and thought the reason for his power must be very high-ranked innate skills.

Some even believed he must have obtained the legacy of a legendary creature in the legendary realm, after all, everyone there knew that this boy was one of the first returnees of the tenth Ruined Realm.
So it was not strange that he could have found something there, something that caused his current power.
No one knew the answer, but everyone agreed on one thing, Lian Vorhelm was a prodigy.
A prodigy whose name might one day be known all over the world and even beyond.
"In the end, how many people got the slots?" in the middle of the talks, one of the foreign guests suddenly asked.
The answer came quickly.
"Three people."
The atmosphere became quiet for a moment.
Three quotas, the top three, but when everyone thought about it, the bitter truth became clear.
Out of the three available quotas... one belonged to Lian Vorhelm, a cast-out Vorhelm.
The second belonged to Seris Pendragon, a girl from the biggest rival clan of the Vorhelms.
And the third belonged to Nova Drakeheart, not even one quota had reached the main contenders of the clan.
This truth landed like another slap on their faces.
Damian had been silent the whole time, he had not said anything, he had not shown any reaction, but his gaze never left Lian.
He could no longer deny anything, no one could, and he was sure the other elders had understood this too... not Lian’s power, not his talent, not the value he had for the clan.
Maybe he still did not have the answers to all his questions, but one thing he was sure of, the boy he had seen today... was not an ordinary genius.

One look was enough to understand that all the representatives of the big guilds of the country and the world who were here, were looking at Lian like a very great treasure, and it was clear they wanted him.
If they did not take him back soon, they might lose him forever.
In the end, one of the elders announced the end of the ceremony, the crowd was ready to leave the stadium, but right at that moment, Damian stood up from his place.
His voice echoed across the whole stadium.
"The people who have obtained the quota of the Celestial Treasury... must be guided there by a guide." He looked at Lian for a few moments and then continued,
"I personally will guide those three people to the Celestial Treasury."
A heavy silence covered the whole stadium.
The faces of many of the clan’s elders immediately turned ugly, some could not even hide their discomfort, but no one said anything, there was no objection, and there was no excuse.
None of their youths had succeeded, none of them, and now the only ones who had the right to enter the Heavenly Treasury were...
Lian Vorhelm, Seris Pendragon, and Nova Drakeheart, for many of the Vorhelms present in the stadium, it was something close to madness.
The faces of the young members of the Vorhelm clan were also disappointed... this was supposed to be the stage of their brilliance... but it became the greatest stage of their humiliation.
In the end, they just lowered their heads and, while they were ready to be punished by the clan elders... they left that place.
And it did not take long until, except for the three champions and Damian... no one else was there.

sentences.text: The battle was over, but no one was getting up from their place.

Thousands of people were staring at the field in silence, at the boy who was not even supposed to reach the second round, at the boy who was supposed to be a sacrifice for the political games of the clan.
At the boy who was supposed to join history as a loser.
But now... he was the only person standing in the center of the field, and the champion of this tournament.
A gentle wind passed over the destroyed ground, blood could still be seen on Lian’s clothes.

His body was full of wounds, but he was still standing, and that was enough, that was enough for him to become the first place of this tournament, someone that no one expected to even make it into the top ten.
And the result?
He became the first place!
And with no cheating, only with pure power.
For the first few minutes, almost no one spoke, not even a whisper could be heard, as if everyone’s brains were still processing the events they had seen today.
In the special section of the Vorhelm clan, Celestia sat motionless, her appearance still seemed calm, but only she knew what storm was raging inside her.
All her plans were passing through her mind one after another.
Darius...
Adrian...
Cassius and even Seris.
Every stage of this tournament had been carefully designed, every obstacle, every choice, every scheme, everything was supposed to lead to one result.
Lian’s defeat.
But the final result was exactly the opposite, every person who was supposed to stop him had been defeated.
Everyone who had bet on him had fallen, and now the same boy who was supposed to be eliminated from the scene... was standing on the highest point.
Celestia unconsciously clenched her fists, her nails digging into the skin of her palms, she felt something inside her chest breaking.
Rage, humiliation, fear, and more than all of that... the feeling of losing control.
She had spent her whole life controlling situations, but now everything was out of her hands.
Worse than that... the whole stadium had seen this defeat.
All the nobles, all the clans, all their allies and enemies, everyone had witnessed her plans being destroyed.
At that moment, if someone looked into her eyes, they could see that behind that artificial calmness, something like madness was forming.
This was a defeat that was going to cost her a very heavy price.
She stared at Lian with madness in her eyes... she would never forget this humiliation and defeat, and she would definitely return it to him a thousand times over one day.
In another part of the section, the elders of the Vorhelm clan had gathered together.
No one was smiling, no one was happy, and the atmosphere was heavier than ever.
"How is that possible?" one of the elders said in a low voice.
Another did not take his gaze off the field.
"I don’t know."
"But it happened."
Another older man sighed.
"We had three contenders."
Everyone knew what he meant.
Cassius.
Evangeline.
Adrian.
Lucas.
Of course, Aron and Eliza were also there, but they had no chance of winning.
Three geniuses of the new generation, three people who were supposed to protect the clan’s reputation.
But none of them had succeeded, none of them!
The only one from their clan who could make it into the top three ranks and become the first place... the only person who had the Vorhelm family name and had taken the quota...
Was Lian.
The boy who had been cast out years ago, this truth was more painful than the defeat itself, of course, there was also another truth.
Cassius and Evangeline were not the only geniuses of the clan, Diana was still growing, her talent was greater than many of the youths present.
The patriarch’s two other children had not participated in this competition at all, one of them even had a five-star class.

The reality was that Lian today had defeated everyone who stood against him.

Old grudges or the future of the clan, they could not have both.

"Really interesting."

Lian.

How many stars?"

chapters.title: Chapter 125: Celestial Treasury I
paragraphs: The sun had passed the middle of the sky for a long time now.
The noise of the competition had faded and the shouts had gone silent, and after hours of battle and competition, a calm silence had settled over the main territory of the Vorhelm clan.
Three people were moving along an old stone road.
Lian Vorhelm, Seris Pendragon, Nova Drakeheart, and in front of them Damian Vorhelm was walking.
This path went into the depths of the clan’s territory, a place where even most of the clan members were never allowed to enter.
On both sides of the road were old trees, some of which were probably over a hundred years old.
A gentle wind flowed among the branches, and unlike the competition field, there was no excitement or pressure here.
Just silence... Damian did not say anything for a long time, as if he was lost in thought, then suddenly his voice broke the silence of the path.
"Congratulations."
All three looked at him, and in silence they listened to whatever he was going to say.
"All of you fought well."
Then his gaze fixed on Lian and he was silent for a few seconds, then he said slowly.
"But I have to admit... you were far beyond what I expected."
"Then I won the bet." A faint smile appeared on Lian’s face, of course he had not forgotten their bet.
Because of that same bet he had planned to treat his family a little easier, but unfortunately Celestia’s behavior did not allow that to happen.
Damian stared at him for a few moments, then shook his head.
"That’s right, you won the bet." No further explanation was needed, both of them knew exactly what that bet meant.
A bet that at that time seemed almost impossible, he himself had made this bet only so that he could bring this boy back to the clan.
At that time he thought he had been clever and had taken advantage of Lian’s pride and arrogance and had forced him to accept a bet that he would definitely lose.
But it turned out that at that time he was the foolish and arrogant one, not his nephew, and now he had decisively lost that bet.
Then Damian spoke again.
"From now on, no one from the Vorhelm clan will cause you trouble or bother you." His voice was completely serious.
"At least as long as I am alive." Then he paused briefly and continued.
"But are you still sure you don’t want to come back?"
Nova unconsciously raised her head, even Seris gave Lian a quick look, they did not understand what these two were talking about, but whatever it was, it seemed interesting.
While it did not matter to Seris, Nova felt that this information might be useful.
Damian continued.
"If you come back, you will become the center of the clan, no one can ignore you anymore, no one, and you can definitely compete for the inheritance."
"My mind has not changed." But Lian’s answer came almost immediately.
Damian did not say anything for a few seconds, then he let out a long sigh, a sigh that smelled more of disappointment than of tiredness.
"Then I can’t do anything." There was no anger in his voice, only acceptance, he had already understood that he could not change Lian’s decision.
A few minutes later he suddenly let out a short laugh, a strange laugh that came from satisfaction and not mockery or humiliation.
"But you should know one thing, the others are going crazy." Damian continued.
"If they could turn back time... they would do anything to stop you from coming back, especially those two women and the factions behind them."
"They are going to suffer a lot from this ceremony and especially the duels, the humiliation is nothing, more elders and members of the clan will now turn against them."
"I can even now smell the regret that they did not try to stop your return haha."
"Fools, they thought that by your return they could finally eliminate you for good."
For a moment Lian did not say anything, this was something he could imagine very well, the humiliation his family had suffered was not as simple as it seemed.
None of the clan’s youths could make it into the top three, and the entire clan would hold Celestia responsible for this, and that was enough for her to gradually become isolated.
If Seraphina was here she would definitely be shocked... because Lian had told her that he would make the Vorhelm clan regret trying to force him back.
And that really did happen in the end... she would probably find out sooner or later, the news of today would not take long to spread.
A calm smile appeared on his face and then he asked.
"But in any case, they could not stop my return, none of them can stop the patriarch’s orders, right?"
Damian did not even think for a moment.
"That’s right, none of them." His voice was completely firm, this was a truth that no one in the Vorhelm clan could deny.

The ultimate power was still in the hands of the patriarch, it did not matter how many elders opposed him, it did not matter how many factions had formed, if the patriarch decided to bring Lian back... no one could stand against him.
After that Damian changed the subject.
"Now let me explain about the Celestial Treasury."
This time the attention of all three was completely caught, even Seris, who was usually indifferent to most things.
"The Celestial Treasury was built about two hundred and fifty years ago, after the first great wave of exploration of the Ruined Realms."
"At that time the great clans realized that some treasures were too valuable to be kept in ordinary storage, so each clan built a great treasury for itself."
He paused for a moment.
"We Vorhelms built the Celestial Treasury."
"From that time until today... every generation of Vorhelms has added their best achievements and the best treasures they obtained to the treasury.
"And now inside it there are things whose value some of them cannot even be measured."
"Like what?" Nova asked quietly, where she came from, even though it was a powerful force, they did not have anything close to the Celestial Treasury.
Damian smiled.
"Ancient and legendary weapons, combat legacies, cores of very powerful monsters, monster corpses, rare skill books, skills that were lost centuries ago."
Then he fixed his gaze forward.
"Some of the things inside the treasury... even for me, they have incalculable value."
This sentence made Nova unconsciously take a deep breath, if Damian was saying such a thing... then the real value of the treasury was probably beyond imagination.
Her eyes shone with excitement... if she could obtain such a thing, maybe she could even become the best in her guild and obtain the position of the next leader.
The further they went, the more the surroundings changed, the trees became fewer, the rocks became larger, and the air seemed heavier.
After a while they entered an area that was clearly different from the rest.
Powerful guards were stationed in various places, each of them alone seemed stronger than many of the awakened ones in the government’s army that Lian had seen.
Shining lines could be seen on the ground, complex magical arrays, multiple protective layers, and mana waves were constantly flowing in the air.
"This level of protection... it’s like they are protecting the heart of an empire." Nova thought to herself.
Her entire guild did not have this much protection!
Finally they reached the end of the path, but there was nothing there, no building and no castle, no gate and not even a cave, practically nothing!.
Just an empty space.
Nova frowned.
Seris also seemed a little curious for the first time.
"Where is it?" she looked around and asked.
Damian smiled, then he took a step forward, raised his hand and placed his palm on the empty space in front of him.
At that same moment... the air began to ripple, like the surface of a calm lake when a stone is thrown into it.
The ripples grew larger, space bent and then... a crack appeared in reality itself.
Nova’s eyes opened wide in surprise, even Lian was silent for a moment, a massive energy was pouring out from inside the crack.
Old, ancient and powerful, as if another world existed on the other side of the crack.
Damian stepped toward it, then turned to the three, a faint smile appeared on his face.
"Welcome to the Celestial Treasury of the Vorhelm clan."

chapters.title: Chapter 126: Celestial Treasury II
paragraphs: Damian was standing in front of the spatial crack, a crack that looked more like a wound on reality than a normal gateway.
Huge waves of energy were pouring out from inside it, the air around was trembling slowly.
Even Nova, who had grown up her whole life in one of the most powerful guilds in the world, felt her heart become a little heavy.
Seris also fixed her gaze on the crack for a few moments, there was something inside it, something very old, something whose greatness could be felt even from this distance.
Lian was also a little surprised, even he who had grown up in this clan did not expect that the Celestial Treasury was actually inside a pocket dimension.
But with a second thought it seemed logical, a treasury that could hold treasures, weapons and items from 9 different worlds, would have to be as big as an entire dimension.
Damian placed his hands behind his back, his eyes moved over all three for a moment and then he said.
"Maybe the greatest treasure house in the world is right here."
"At least as far as I know, there is no treasury with this volume of legacies, ancient artifacts and forgotten treasures."
"Some of the things sleeping inside this treasury, were obtained from civilizations that might be older than the entire history of our world."
"Inside this treasury there are things that have been collected from 9 different worlds, saying it is easy, but I am sure you cannot even imagine what that means." He paused briefly.
"You are lucky to have been allowed to enter it, this is an opportunity that, if you were not blessed enough to be born with Vorhelm blood, you could never have."
Nova took a quiet breath and then stared at the crack and asked.
"When we go in, how do we find what we need? There must be millions of items in there."
Damian gave a faint smile.
"That is where it gets interesting." He pointed at the crack.
"The Celestial Treasury is not just a big warehouse, at the center of this dimension, there is a consciousness, a consciousness that protects the entire treasury."
None of the three were that surprised, this was a normal matter, for protecting such places, spiritual consciousnesses or artificial consciousnesses were used.

With science, artificial consciousness could be created, and with magic, spiritual consciousnesses could be created, this was the science and technology that all organizations and powers in the world used.
Damian continued.
"As soon as you enter, each of you will be separated from the others, sent to different sections, there is no way to find each other."
"And no one can affect another’s path." He paused for a moment.
"What you find depends on yourselves, on luck, on fate and on the choices you make inside the treasury.
"I thought there was no limit." Lian frowned.

"There is no limit in terms of choice, anything you find and have the conditions to take, is yours, of course, as you know, some weapons have their own spirits, if you find a spirit weapon, the weapon’s spirit must approve of you." Damian nodded.
"But the number of choices and the time are limited."
Then he fixed his gaze on Lian.
"First place, Lian Vorhelm, you have three choices and thirty minutes."
Then his gaze went to Seris.
"Second place, Seris Pendragon, two choices and twenty minutes."
And finally he looked at Nova.
"Third place, Nova Drachheart, one choice and ten minutes."
"After the time ends, the treasury will forcefully eject you." He then added.
No one objected, maybe the number they could take was small but they did not care much about it, in fact, none of them even had time to think about these limitations.
Their minds were completely occupied by the massive crack in front of them.
"It is time now, I wish you the best." Damian stepped aside.
Nova was the first one, without hesitation she entered the crack, her body disappeared into the light.
Seris was the next one, she just gave Lian a quick look, a look whose meaning was not clear, then she calmly entered the gateway and disappeared.
Finally only Lian remained, he looked at the crack for a few seconds, then without any hesitation he stepped forward and entered.
Light, pressure, energy and then... silence... he felt his whole body floating in an ocean of light.
Time had lost its meaning, space did not exist, directions had disappeared, but a few moments later everything suddenly became calm.
His feet landed on a solid surface, Lian slowly opened his eyes and for a few seconds he showed no reaction, because of what was in front of him.
His eyes slowly widened, the entire horizon in front of him was covered with treasures, but not like a warehouse and not like a normal treasury, but like a complete world.
A golden sky was spread above him, clouds of light were floating in the heights, massive crystal pillars stretched up to the middle of the sky.
Some of them were so tall that their ends could not be seen, among those pillars rivers of light were flowing.
Of course, not water, but pure energy, floating islands were suspended in the air, on some of them legendary swords were placed, on others floating books whose pages were turning by themselves.
Trees could be seen that carried shining crystals instead of leaves, each branch of them had a value that could make a clan rich.
In the distance armors were suspended, armors that even from hundreds of meters away were releasing massive pressure.
There were swords that seemed alive by themselves, spears around which storms had formed.
Books from whose pages celestial light was coming out, stones inside which stars were imprisoned.
And thousands... no... millions of other treasures.
Lian breathed slowly, in his life he had seen many things and heard about many things... monsters that could destroy cities, ruins in previous Ruined Realms that dated back to forgotten ages.
Legacies that had caused the massacre of clans.
But here... this place... was on another level, it was like the true heaven of treasures.
Everything he looked at had unimaginable value.
Even the weakest item he saw could probably start a war, after a long time he was truly amazed.
At that moment... a voice echoed in his mind, a voice that was neither male nor female, neither old nor young, and a voice that seemed to originate from the world itself.
"Welcome!..."
Lian immediately frowned, his eyes searched around, but there was no one there, but if his guess was not wrong, this voice must belong to the consciousness of this treasury.
The voice repeated again.
"Your time has begun, you have thirty minutes and three choices, so you better not waste your opportunity!"
The next moment the entire world in front of him began to shine; millions of treasures simultaneously emitted a faint light.
"But how should I choose?" he stared ahead with a frown.
If he wanted to see each and every one of these treasures and items and examine them one by one, he could easily take decades and maybe hundreds of years.
And as far as he could see and guess... this was only a small part of the entire Celestial Treasury.
"My god... the current generation of Vorhelms seem completely trash... but it seems I had really good ancestors."

sentences.text: Damian was standing in front of the spatial crack, a crack that looked more like a wound on reality than a normal gateway.
Huge waves of energy were pouring out from inside it, the air around was trembling slowly.
Even Nova, who had grown up her whole life in one of the most powerful guilds in the world, felt her heart become a little heavy.
Seris also fixed her gaze on the crack for a few moments, there was something inside it, something very old, something whose greatness could be felt even from this distance.
Lian was also a little surprised, even he who had grown up in this clan did not expect that the Celestial Treasury was actually inside a pocket dimension.
But with a second thought it seemed logical, a treasury that could hold treasures, weapons and items from 9 different worlds, would have to be as big as an entire dimension.
Damian placed his hands behind his back, his eyes moved over all three for a moment and then he said.
"Maybe the greatest treasure house in the world is right here."
"At least as far as I know, there is no treasury with this volume of legacies, ancient artifacts and forgotten treasures."
"Some of the things sleeping inside this treasury, were obtained from civilizations that might be older than the entire history of our world."
"Inside this treasury there are things that have been collected from 9 different worlds, saying it is easy, but I am sure you cannot even imagine what that means." He paused briefly.
"You are lucky to have been allowed to enter it, this is an opportunity that, if you were not blessed enough to be born with Vorhelm blood, you could never have."
Nova took a quiet breath and then stared at the crack and asked.
"When we go in, how do we find what we need?
There must be millions of items in there."
Damian gave a faint smile.
"That is where it gets interesting." He pointed at the crack.
"The Celestial Treasury is not just a big warehouse, at the center of this dimension, there is a consciousness, a consciousness that protects the entire treasury."
None of the three were that surprised, this was a normal matter, for protecting such places, spiritual consciousnesses or artificial consciousnesses were used.

With science, artificial consciousness could be created, and with magic, spiritual consciousnesses could be created, this was the science and technology that all organizations and powers in the world used.
Damian continued.
"As soon as you enter, each of you will be separated from the others, sent to different sections, there is no way to find each other."
"And no one can affect another’s path." He paused for a moment.
"What you find depends on yourselves, on luck, on fate and on the choices you make inside the treasury.
"I thought there was no limit." Lian frowned.

"There is no limit in terms of choice, anything you find and have the conditions to take, is yours, of course, as you know, some weapons have their own spirits, if you find a spirit weapon, the weapon’s spirit must approve of you." Damian nodded.
"But the number of choices and the time are limited."
Then he fixed his gaze on Lian.
"First place, Lian Vorhelm, you have three choices and thirty minutes."
Then his gaze went to Seris.
"Second place, Seris Pendragon, two choices and twenty minutes."
And finally he looked at Nova.
"Third place, Nova Drachheart, one choice and ten minutes."
"After the time ends, the treasury will forcefully eject you." He then added.
No one objected, maybe the number they could take was small but they did not care much about it, in fact, none of them even had time to think about these limitations.
Their minds were completely occupied by the massive crack in front of them.
"It is time now, I wish you the best." Damian stepped aside.
Nova was the first one, without hesitation she entered the crack, her body disappeared into the light.
Seris was the next one, she just gave Lian a quick look, a look whose meaning was not clear, then she calmly entered the gateway and disappeared.
Finally only Lian remained, he looked at the crack for a few seconds, then without any hesitation he stepped forward and entered.
Light, pressure, energy and then... silence... he felt his whole body floating in an ocean of light.
Time had lost its meaning, space did not exist, directions had disappeared, but a few moments later everything suddenly became calm.
His feet landed on a solid surface, Lian slowly opened his eyes and for a few seconds he showed no reaction, because of what was in front of him.
His eyes slowly widened, the entire horizon in front of him was covered with treasures, but not like a warehouse and not like a normal treasury, but like a complete world.
A golden sky was spread above him, clouds of light were floating in the heights, massive crystal pillars stretched up to the middle of the sky.
Some of them were so tall that their ends could not be seen, among those pillars rivers of light were flowing.
Of course, not water, but pure energy, floating islands were suspended in the air, on some of them legendary swords were placed, on others floating books whose pages were turning by themselves.
Trees could be seen that carried shining crystals instead of leaves, each branch of them had a value that could make a clan rich.
In the distance armors were suspended, armors that even from hundreds of meters away were releasing massive pressure.
There were swords that seemed alive by themselves, spears around which storms had formed.
Books from whose pages celestial light was coming out, stones inside which stars were imprisoned.
And thousands... no... millions of other treasures.
Lian breathed slowly, in his life he had seen many things and heard about many things... monsters that could destroy cities, ruins in previous Ruined Realms that dated back to forgotten ages.
Legacies that had caused the massacre of clans.
But here... this place... was on another level, it was like the true heaven of treasures.
Everything he looked at had unimaginable value.
Even the weakest item he saw could probably start a war, after a long time he was truly amazed.
At that moment... a voice echoed in his mind, a voice that was neither male nor female, neither old nor young, and a voice that seemed to originate from the world itself.
"Welcome!..."
Lian immediately frowned, his eyes searched around, but there was no one there, but if his guess was not wrong, this voice must belong to the consciousness of this treasury.
The voice repeated again.
"Your time has begun, you have thirty minutes and three choices, so you better not waste your opportunity!"
The next moment the entire world in front of him began to shine; millions of treasures simultaneously emitted a faint light.
"But how should I choose?" he stared ahead with a frown.
If he wanted to see each and every one of these treasures and items and examine them one by one, he could easily take decades and maybe hundreds of years.
And as far as he could see and guess... this was only a small part of the entire Celestial Treasury.
"My god... the current generation of Vorhelms seem completely trash... but it seems I had really good ancestors."

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Celestial Treasury III
paragraphs: Lian was walking calmly through the endless world of the Celestial Treasury.
Above him a golden sky was spread out and floating islands were moving gently among the glowing clouds.
About ten minutes had passed since he started searching this treasury, but he had not been able to choose anything, choosing among all these treasures was not an easy task.
In fact, it was maybe one of the hardest things he had ever done in his life.
Every time he found something that he thought was worth it, a few seconds later he would see the same thing but with higher quality and rank, and this cycle continued.
Everywhere he looked, there was a treasure that could change the fate of a power.
And this had made him want to trust his intuition, maybe this way he could choose the best.
But the strangest part of it all was that none of them caught his intuition’s attention.

A vague feeling deep inside him was guiding him somewhere else. It was as if something in the distance was waiting for him, something that had been calling him since the moment he entered the treasury.
Along his path he passed by dozens of floating platforms. On one of them was a sword with blue flames dancing around its blade.
Just the pressure coming from it was enough to show that it was a weapon beyond imagination.
The voice of the treasury’s consciousness whispered in his mind.
"Azur Celestial Sword, legacy of one of the Unholy Ones of the third Ruined Realm, capable of splitting mountains."
Lian just glanced at it, then continued on his way.
No... this was not it, besides, he did not need a sword, and even if he wanted one, he would prefer to choose a sword that was unique.
A few minutes later he passed by an armor that was suspended in a field of light, its surface covered with thousands of shining runes.

Each of those runes had a value that could drive academies into madness, if this armor was placed on an awakened one’s body, their defensive power would multiply several times, it had an S rank quality.
S rank armors were bought and sold for hundreds of millions of dollars and they could not be found just anywhere, they were mostly controlled by powerful clans, guilds and governments.
But still... he had no feeling.
No... this was not it either, his intuition was saying no to this too.
"I hope my intuition does not let me down."
A little further ahead, a floating book caught his attention, its pages turning by themselves.
On each page thousands of ancient symbols could be seen, just one look was enough for Lian to understand that this was not a normal skill.
It was probably a skill with potential even higher than Divine rank.
Skills could be upgraded up to five ranks, Common, Great, Divine, which were the highest rank skills he currently had.
But that does not mean that Divine is the highest rank of a skill... in fact, there are two ranks above it, Holy and Eternal.
Although skills that have potential beyond Divine rank are very rare, and above Holy rank, even rarer.

There are less than a hundred known skills in the world that have the potential to reach Eternal rank, and considering that there are millions of skills, and maybe even more, this number below a hundred is insane.
But he only looked at it for a few seconds, after examining it he understood that it was a speed skill, it is not that it was bad, but he felt he did not need it, and then he passed by.
If it was a defensive, offensive or healing skill, he would have chosen it without a doubt.
The more he moved forward, the more he realized the real danger of the Celestial Treasury.
This place was not just a treasure house; this place was a living temptation, every few minutes a treasure would appear that would destroy any human’s sanity.
At one point on his path he saw another S rank sword, at another point he saw the core of an Unholy monster whose power aura was still alive.
This was a monster core that was equal to a Dreadmaw Sovereign.
Several times he also saw books that just looking at them increased the flow of mana in his body.
Every time he was tempted for a few moments, every time his mind started calculating, if I take this... if I choose that... if I use this opportunity...
But in the end a strange feeling always stopped him, as if something more important was waiting for him, something that had the value of all these treasures combined.
Gradually he realized a truth, now he understood that this place had limited entry and even clan members could not come whenever they wanted.
The temptation here was insane, he was barely controlling himself from picking up everything he saw, if he could he would just take everything for himself.
"Why don’t you stop?" the treasury’s voice echoed in his mind again, this time clearer than before.
"Why should I stop?" Lian did not stop his steps.
A few seconds of silence followed, then the voice spoke again.
"You passed by treasures that many rulers of the world would be willing to destroy countries for, why did you not choose any of them?"
Lian gave a faint smile.
"Because what I am looking for has not been found yet."
For a few moments a long silence followed, then the treasury’s voice whispered more quietly than before.
"Interesting..." it was the first time something like curiosity could be felt in its voice.
And Lian noticed this too, it seemed the treasury’s consciousness was no longer just observing him, but had become interested in him.
But this was not something he cared about at the moment.
The further he went, the more he noticed something strange, what was calling him was not located in the center of the treasury.
In fact, the opposite, the closer he got to it, the fewer treasures there were around.
Mana pressure decreased, light became less, the grandeur of the area lowered, this did not make sense.
Normally the most valuable treasures were kept in the heart of the treasury, but this thing... what his intuition was looking for... was guiding him toward the forgotten sections.
To areas that even the treasury’s consciousness apparently did not care much about, this only made him more curious.
In another part of the treasury... Seris was walking calmly among a forest of floating swords.
Unlike Lian, her path was straight, she had no hesitation, no temptation stopped her, hundreds of treasures were around her.
But she did not even look at them, her silver eyes were only following one destination.
The treasury’s consciousness was also watching her with interest.
This girl was strange, very strange, most humans entered the treasury and searched madly for power.
But this girl... did not want power, she ignored legendary weapons, she rejected rare books.
She did not even look at valuable cores, as if she was looking for something else, something very personal, something that only she knew what it was.
In the depths of the treasury, in a place far from reach, an old sword was waiting in silence for its owner to find it...
Lian did not know how long he had walked, maybe a few minutes, maybe more, but he could see that only 10 minutes of time remained for him.
And suddenly he noticed that his surroundings had completely changed.
The massive pillars had disappeared, the rivers of light were no longer visible, even the mana pressure of the environment had decreased.
This place looked almost abandoned, and in the center of this area... there was an old stone platform.
A platform that showed signs of wear from time, on it there was only one object.
A cracked red core, a core whose surface was covered with deep cracks.
But what caught Lian’s attention was not its appearance, but the aura that was coming from it.
A dark, destructive and ominous aura, an aura that was different from all the treasures he had seen until today.
Even now he could understand the reason this area was abandoned, no one was willing to get close to such a thing.
But the moment his gaze fell on the core...
His heart pounded strongly, its beat suddenly multiplied several times, a strange feeling rose from the depths of his being, as if something in his blood had awakened.
And right at that moment... the system notification appeared.
[ You have found a Demon’s Core ]
