chapters.title: Chapter 134: The First Time Using A Celestial Book
paragraphs: Lian was sitting on the Windrunner Strider and looking at the massive gates of the base.
Hundreds of awakened ones were coming and going, some were just returning from hunting, others were getting ready to enter unknown areas.
But he was in no hurry, this was his first real day after returning to the Ruined Realm.
The first day was always important, the first day determined how he would plan the rest of his path.
With a gentle move, he pulled the reins, the riding monster under him let out a short neigh and passed through the gate, a few seconds later the base was behind him.
And the Ruined Realm showed itself again, Lian was silent for a moment.
This world was different from the outside world, the sky was still and considerably red.

But the clouds were normal, the wind was blowing, trees were growing, and everything was bigger, more extreme, the mountains that could be seen in the distance were easily several times taller than the mountains of the normal world.
There were trees whose height was more than multi-story buildings, rivers could be seen that looked more like moving lakes.
And more importantly... mana, mana was everywhere, in the air, in the soil, in the plants.
Even breathing here was different from the outside world, if a normal human entered this place, they would probably notice the difference in the first few minutes.

Lian gave a faint smile, he was finally back, the previous time he was here was against his will and he had come completely by force, but now that he looks at it, that event was a blessing and a miracle for him.
Today he was not going to enter dangerous areas, at least not for now, his goal was simple.

Examining the surrounding areas, understanding the environment, evaluating the monsters, and more importantly... testing the Celestial Book of Treasure, a book that even he himself did not have a proper understanding of yet and needed to test it.
He reached his hand toward the storage space, a moment later the book appeared, its cover shone under the sunlight.
Even now, its appearance looked more like a sacred artifact than a normal tool.
Lian opened it, at that same moment the pages began to shine, mana flowed through the golden lines and the system notification appeared.
[Scanning Surroundings...]
A few seconds passed, then the light came out from the pages and expanded right in front of his eyes in the form of a 3D map.
Lian unconsciously raised his eyebrows, the map was floating in the air, precise, clear and with incredible detail.
Different areas were marked on it, sections in green, sections in yellow, sections in red, and even a few black spots could be seen.
He quickly understood their meaning.

Safe areas, medium risk areas, deadly areas, dungeons, ruins and areas containing resources, it had practically shown anywhere that had the slightest sign of treasure, but only up to a radius of ten kilometers.
Beyond that, everything was dark, like fog in games, Lian stared at the map for a few seconds, the more he looked, the more he understood the value of this book.

If this tool fell into the hands of a big guild... if it fell into the hands of the army... or even into the hands of a powerful clan... they could exactly build something similar to the Celestial Treasury.
The book suddenly lit up a few small points.
Lian lowered his gaze.

The first point, a rare plant rank D, the second point, a mana crystal rank E which seemed to indicate the lowest quality, the third point, a rare metal rank D, none of them were special or high rank.
Most of them were so worthless that going after them was itself a waste of time.
But this made him smile, this meant the book does not only show big treasures, but tracks anything that is valuable.
A unique tool for exploration, he kept the book open and continued on his path.
Hours passed.
Along the way he saw different areas, the Emerald Forest, a vast area where its green trees almost swallowed the sunlight.
According to the map’s information, many plant monsters lived there.
Predator trees, poisonous flowers, and creatures that looked more like plant monsters than animals.
A little further ahead was the stone plain, where dozens of rock rhinos that were made of stone were moving among the rocks.
Most of them were below level fifteen, and there were not that many of them, but that still made them dangerous for beginners.
He, as much as he could, one-shot those that attacked him with simple attacks.
And notifications about killing monsters kept appearing for him one after another.
[ You killed a level 7 horned rock rhino. ]
[ You gained three stats points. ]
[ You killed a level 7 horned rock rhino. ]
[ You gained three stats points. ]
[ You killed a level 9 bloodthirsty tree. ]
[ You gained three stats points. ]
[ You killed a... ]
Then he reached the Red Valley, a massive valley whose walls still carried the marks of old battles on them.

Some cracks were so large that they seemed to have been made by gigantic creatures, Lian knew many of these marks were related to the battles of the people of this same world with the monsters, trying to protect their world.
Battles whose marks still remained.
Along the way he saw many groups, students who were moving in groups, guild members who had identical equipment.
Independent hunters who traveled alone, some were hunting, some were collecting resources.
Some were mapping, and some were just moving toward farther areas.
The Ruined Realm really looked like an independent world, as if millions of people were living in a massive game and each person followed their own path.
He did not bother them, and they also completely ignored him and continued with their own work.
The sun was slowly moving toward the horizon, he had advanced more than 297 kilometers, had randomly killed dozens of monsters, and had managed to gain 49 stats points.
But at least in these 297 kilometers, he had not seen anything special, even those large herds of monsters were nowhere to be seen, as if they were not around here.
Lian was examining the last three remaining kilometers when suddenly the book reacted.
He immediately stopped, his eyes fixed on the map. For the first time since morning, finally a different color appeared.
Not blue, not green, not white, but golden! A golden point lit up in the eastern part of the map and a new notification was written on the book.
[High Value Treasure Detected. ]
[Sunheart Bloom. ]
[Rank: A. ]

[Description: A legendary flower born from concentrated mana. Consuming it significantly increases physical vitality, accelerates mana circulation and permanently strengthens the body’s affinity with mana by 55%. One of the primary ingredients used in high-grade body refinement elixirs. ]
[Distance: 9.1 Kilometers. ]
[Threat Level: Medium. ]
Lian stared at the notification for a few seconds.
Rank A.
This was the first truly valuable treasure that the book had found for him, even in the base market, such a thing could be sold for an astronomical price.
But something more than its financial value caught his attention.
The threat level was medium, the book usually had information about surrounding dangers, and until now, all the threat levels he had seen were safe levels.
But finally a medium threat level appeared!
The sun had almost set, the most logical decision was to return to the base, he could continue tomorrow too.
But... curiosity would not allow it, he looked at the golden point again.
Nine kilometers distance, for the Windrunner Strider it was not a long time, and more importantly... this was the first important treasure the book had found.
Lian gently pulled the reins of his riding monster and then changed his direction, and moved toward the golden point.

Today he was not going to enter dangerous areas, at least not for now, his goal was simple.

Examining the surrounding areas, understanding the environment, evaluating the monsters, and more importantly... testing the Celestial Book of Treasure, a book that even he himself did not have a proper understanding of yet and needed to test it.
He reached his hand toward the storage space, a moment later the book appeared, its cover shone under the sunlight.
Even now, its appearance looked more like a sacred artifact than a normal tool.
Lian opened it, at that same moment the pages began to shine, mana flowed through the golden lines and the system notification appeared.
[Scanning Surroundings...]
A few seconds passed, then the light came out from the pages and expanded right in front of his eyes in the form of a 3D map.
Lian unconsciously raised his eyebrows, the map was floating in the air, precise, clear and with incredible detail.
Different areas were marked on it, sections in green, sections in yellow, sections in red, and even a few black spots could be seen.
He quickly understood their meaning.

Safe areas, medium risk areas, deadly areas, dungeons, ruins and areas containing resources, it had practically shown anywhere that had the slightest sign of treasure, but only up to a radius of ten kilometers.
Beyond that, everything was dark, like fog in games, Lian stared at the map for a few seconds, the more he looked, the more he understood the value of this book.

If this tool fell into the hands of a big guild... if it fell into the hands of the army... or even into the hands of a powerful clan... they could exactly build something similar to the Celestial Treasury.
The book suddenly lit up a few small points.
Lian lowered his gaze.

The first point, a rare plant rank D, the second point, a mana crystal rank E which seemed to indicate the lowest quality, the third point, a rare metal rank D, none of them were special or high rank.
Most of them were so worthless that going after them was itself a waste of time.
But this made him smile, this meant the book does not only show big treasures, but tracks anything that is valuable.
A unique tool for exploration, he kept the book open and continued on his path.
Hours passed.
Along the way he saw different areas, the Emerald Forest, a vast area where its green trees almost swallowed the sunlight.
According to the map’s information, many plant monsters lived there.
Predator trees, poisonous flowers, and creatures that looked more like plant monsters than animals.
A little further ahead was the stone plain, where dozens of rock rhinos that were made of stone were moving among the rocks.
Most of them were below level fifteen, and there were not that many of them, but that still made them dangerous for beginners.
He, as much as he could, one-shot those that attacked him with simple attacks.
And notifications about killing monsters kept appearing for him one after another.
[ You killed a level 7 horned rock rhino. ]
[ You gained three stats points. ]
[ You killed a level 7 horned rock rhino. ]
[ You gained three stats points. ]
[ You killed a level 9 bloodthirsty tree. ]
[ You gained three stats points. ]
[ You killed a... ]
Then he reached the Red Valley, a massive valley whose walls still carried the marks of old battles on them.

Some cracks were so large that they seemed to have been made by gigantic creatures, Lian knew many of these marks were related to the battles of the people of this same world with the monsters, trying to protect their world.
Battles whose marks still remained.
Along the way he saw many groups, students who were moving in groups, guild members who had identical equipment.
Independent hunters who traveled alone, some were hunting, some were collecting resources.
Some were mapping, and some were just moving toward farther areas.
The Ruined Realm really looked like an independent world, as if millions of people were living in a massive game and each person followed their own path.
He did not bother them, and they also completely ignored him and continued with their own work.
The sun was slowly moving toward the horizon, he had advanced more than 297 kilometers, had randomly killed dozens of monsters, and had managed to gain 49 stats points.
But at least in these 297 kilometers, he had not seen anything special, even those large herds of monsters were nowhere to be seen, as if they were not around here.
Lian was examining the last three remaining kilometers when suddenly the book reacted.
He immediately stopped, his eyes fixed on the map.
For the first time since morning, finally a different color appeared.
Not blue, not green, not white, but golden!
A golden point lit up in the eastern part of the map and a new notification was written on the book.
[High Value Treasure Detected. ]
[Sunheart Bloom. ]
[Rank: A. ]
[Description: A legendary flower born from concentrated mana.
Consuming it significantly increases physical vitality, accelerates mana circulation and permanently strengthens the body’s affinity with mana by 55%.
One of the primary ingredients used in high-grade body refinement elixirs. ]
[Distance: 9.1 Kilometers. ]
[Threat Level: Medium. ]
Lian stared at the notification for a few seconds.
Rank A.
This was the first truly valuable treasure that the book had found for him, even in the base market, such a thing could be sold for an astronomical price.
But something more than its financial value caught his attention.
The threat level was medium, the book usually had information about surrounding dangers, and until now, all the threat levels he had seen were safe levels.
But finally a medium threat level appeared!
The sun had almost set, the most logical decision was to return to the base, he could continue tomorrow too.
But... curiosity would not allow it, he looked at the golden point again.
Nine kilometers distance, for the Windrunner Strider it was not a long time, and more importantly... this was the first important treasure the book had found.
Lian gently pulled the reins of his riding monster and then changed his direction, and moved toward the golden point.

chapters.title: Chapter 135: A Level 27 Monster
paragraphs: The cool evening breeze was passing through the grasslands and moving the silver fur of the Windrunner Strider.
Lian was sitting on the saddle and moving through the vast plains of the Ruined Realm at a steady speed, almost a few minutes had passed since he had set out.

During all this time, the book of treasure had not remained still, the further he went, the stronger the book’s reaction became, the golden point on the map kept getting brighter, at first it was just a small mark.
But now it was like a small star floating on the screen, this had made even Lian a little expectant.
He could sell that plant itself for several hundred thousand to several million dollars, and if his guess about the threat level was right, he might find one or several powerful monsters there.
Their corpses would also have their own value, and besides that, he could finally get a significant amount of stats points.
And the plant itself also had many uses, aside from selling it, he could use it himself, the more affinity with mana one has, the less mana one has to pay per minute for each skill to remain active.
For other awakened ones, its uses were even greater, the more their affinity with mana is, the easier and faster it is for them to absorb mana points from mana crystals.
Finally, the Windrunner Strider crossed over a short hill.
Lian fixed his gaze forward, and for a moment his eyebrows went up.
He expected to see something different, maybe an ancient ruin, maybe a forgotten temple, maybe a secret cave, but what was in front of him... was just a plain.
A vast plain, tall grass spread as far as the eye could see, green waves were moving with the wind.
But right in the center of that plain... something was shining.
A golden plant, a plant that seemed to be made of sunlight, its leaves reflected light like polished metal.
Golden veins were flowing on its stem.
Even though the sun was slowly going toward the horizon, the plant was still shining like a small torch in the middle of the plain.
The book’s notification appeared.
[ Sunheart Bloom ]
[ Rank: A ]
Lian’s eyes narrowed slightly, so this was it, he had finally found the plant he had come for.
But almost immediately he noticed the main problem, and the reason why the threat level was Medium.
A few meters from the plant... a monster was standing, a gigantic monster, its height was close to six meters.
Its body looked like a rhinoceros, but no rhinoceros in the normal world had such an appearance, natural armor plates had grown all over its body.
Its skin was dark gray, the massive horn on its head was almost as long as a war spear, every time it breathed, lava vapor came out of its nose, it could shoot lava balls through its mouth!
And more importantly... the system notification.
[ Lava Behemoth ]
[ Rank: Normal ]
[ Level: 27 ]

Lian frowned at that moment, this was the highest level he had seen until today, even the Dreadmaw had a lower level than this monster... although it was definitely stronger, but it was seven levels lower.
And this monster had passed its first evolution, it is true that he had fought monsters in the simulator that were level 25 and had passed their first evolution.
But this is level 27 and real! It is not a simulator.
Just the presence of that creature was enough to activate the sense of danger in his being.
But something was strange, the monster was not standing still, it was fighting.
Lian turned his gaze and only then noticed other people, five people, a full group, three warriors, one healer and one mage.

The ground around them was shouting the state of the battle, the grass was burned, several craters had been created in the ground, and traces of blood could be seen on the monster’s armor and on the awakened ones’ armors.
It was clear this fight had not just started, it had been going on for a long time.
One of the warriors attacked from the left, his sword landed on the monster’s armor and orange sparks spread in the air.
But not much damage was done, the monster turned its body with a short roar, its massive tail moved like a heavy whip.
The warrior had to throw himself back to survive.
At that moment... thunder split the sky.
Lian’s eyes went toward the mage, and for a moment he focused completely on him.
A tall boy, a fit body, golden hair, light green eyes, but what caught the most attention...
It was the lightning element... his lightning was different from Lian’s lightning, very different, more controlled, cleaner and more deadly, as if he had focused on this same element for years.
He raised his hand, a magic circle formed, and the next moment a spear of dense lightning shot toward the monster.
A strong explosion occurred.
The monster stepped back a few steps but this was not the end, the mage immediately cast the next spell.
Chains of lightning formed between several different points and trapped the monster’s body between them, for a moment its movement slowed down, but the power of that creature was too high.
With a roar, it tore the chains apart.
Lian had involuntarily become interested, this was the first time he saw someone controlling the lightning element at such a level.
In fact, until now, apart from himself, he had not seen another awakened one who used lightning, and he himself uses lightning to strengthen and make his punches more deadly.
But this boy was a mage and his way of using lightning was completely different, and he was clearly the strongest member of this group too.
It was as if he was the core of the group and the rest were all his supporters.
But suddenly he felt a strange feeling, the face of that boy... was familiar, very familiar, for a few seconds he tried to remember.
Then he suddenly stopped.
Wait... he had seen this face before, in the news, on posters, on public screens in cities, because this face strongly resembled the President.
The golden-haired boy was almost strangely similar to the country’s President, the same hair, the same eyes, the same face shape.
"Could he be his son?" Lian thought to himself, there is not much information about the President’s son.
Everyone knows he has a son, but his identity has never been officially announced, even who the boy’s mother is is not known.
Whatever it was, the resemblance did not seem coincidental, but very soon he focused on the battle again.
And the more he looked... the more he realized this group was not weak, not weak at all, a level twenty-seven monster was no joke.
But they were still alive, still fighting, they had still managed to wound it.
This meant their power was beyond normal awakened ones, even Lian, if he wanted to stand alone against that monster right now, was not sure he could win.
Fighting? Definitely. Surviving? Definitely. But being able to kill that monster alone? No, he has the ability to kill normal level 25 monsters.
But killing a level 27 monster with his current stats is not possible, the gap is significantly large, at least alone he cannot kill one.
But with the help of a group like this group, there should be no problem and he should be able to successfully kill that monster.
"I still have a long way to go to improve," he laughed quietly.
The battle was not going well, the monster was wounded, but the group was also not in a good condition, one of the warriors was bleeding from the shoulder.
The healer was casting spells repeatedly, but his face was getting whiter by the moment, his mana reserve was almost depleted.
Even the lightning mage was not attacking like before, the battle had entered a war of attrition, and if it continued like this, the losing side was clear from now.
Lian placed his hand on the saddle.
Should he help? Should he wait? Or let both sides weaken and then take the plant?
Logically... there was no reason to interfere, naturally he would not let them die, but he had not decided yet.
At that same moment, one of the warriors suddenly noticed his presence.
A girl, fiery red hair, light armor and a large sword in her hand, a very large sword, her eyes immediately locked onto Lian.
She stared for a few moments and then shouted angrily.
"Hey!" Her voice echoed throughout the plain.
Lian blinked, did this girl call him?
"Either help or get lost, you freeloading bastard!" The girl shouted again.
At that same moment, all the members of the group turned their gazes toward him.
The lightning mage, the other two warriors, even the healer, and worse of all... the Lava Behemoth also turned its massive head toward him.
The monster’s yellow eyes fixed on Lian.
For a few seconds... the entire battlefield fell into silence, and Lian understood that he could no longer just be a spectator.
( The Lava Behemoth’s Visualization )

chapters.title: Chapter 136: Battle With A Level 27 Monster
paragraphs: A few seconds of strange silence ruled over the battlefield.
The wind was passing through the tall grass of the plain and the sound of the Lava Behemoth’s heavy breathing was echoing in the air.
The massive monster was staring at Lian with its bright yellow eyes, the group members were doing the same.
The only one who apparently kept his calm was that lightning mage.
Lian slowly got down from the Windrunner Strider, his riding monster stepped back a few steps and stood silently at the edge of the field.
The red-haired girl was still looking at him with a frown, if her gaze could kill someone, Lian would probably be dead right now.

From her point of view, this man was definitely a freeloader, he had come here and was waiting for them to weaken the monster and get themselves killed, then he would kill the monster and take everything for himself.
She hated this type of people more than anything.
But before she could say anything, the lightning mage stepped forward, unlike the girl who was almost ready to fight, he seemed completely calm.
"If you do not intend to help, just get away from here."
His voice was calm.
"The last thing we need is someone interfering in the middle of the battle."
Lian glanced at the level twenty-seven monster, then looked at the golden plant in the center of the plain.
"If I help, do I get a share of the plant?" He then said indifferently.
For a few moments everyone fell silent, even the sound of the battle seemed to stop.
"What?! You haven’t even joined the battle yet and you are bargaining?! Of course you are not getting anything!" Then Rhea, the red-haired girl, almost exploded.
At that same moment, the Lava Behemoth attacked with a loud roar, the shield-bearing warrior threw himself in front of the group.
The monster’s massive horn hit his shield, the sound of metal echoed across the plain, the burly man was thrown back several meters, but despite this, the argument continued.
In such an environment, this was completely normal, if someone was going to risk their life, they had to get something in return.
Lian was not a bad person, but he was also not a person who would help for free, he definitely would not let these people die, but that was the point, when should he interfere?
He could just watch for now, it was completely clear that this group was losing, and interfere after their defeat.
Or help them right now?
Lian now had the chance to examine the group members better.
The lightning mage, a boy with golden hair and green eyes, tall, calm, composed, and clearly the leader of the group.
Next to him stood the only girl in the group, a girl with fiery red hair and a huge sword that was almost twice her own size.
A bit further away was the shield-bearing warrior, a massive body, muscles like rock, and the main role of protecting the group.
The fourth warrior was a man with two short swords, fast, light, and clearly the main close-range attacker.
The last person was that thin healer boy, his face had turned white, sweat had settled on his forehead.
And he was clearly close to running out of mana.
At that moment, the lightning mage’s gaze fixed on Lian, his eyes shone for a moment, one of his innate skills had been activated, a skill that could estimate the intensity of people’s mana.
And then... his face changed, very slightly, so slightly that maybe no one would notice, but it changed, because what he had sensed was not logical.
The boy in front of him was almost the same age as himself, maybe even one or two years younger, but the amount of mana flowing in his body... was insane.
Not just more than people his age, but even more than all the members of the group, for a moment he even thought his skill had made a mistake.
But that was impossible, his skill never made mistakes.
’Who is this boy?’ For the first time, this question formed in his mind.
He had been in the Ruined Realm all this time, so he was not very aware of the country’s news, and he was not the type to follow the news either.
At that same moment, the red-haired girl attacked again, her massive sword landed on one of the monster’s legs, sparks spread, but the monster’s natural armor only got scratched.
The Lava Behemoth became angrier, magma was boiling out from the cracks in its armor.
"I will pay you half the value of the plant." The lightning mage, or in other words Kael, suddenly said.
"No." Lian shook his head without even a second of thinking.
"Then why are you still here?!" The red-haired girl, or in other words Rhea, almost exploded from anger.
"What do you want?" Kael asked calmly.
Lian did not take his gaze off the plant, he had the book of treasure, he knew exactly what this plant was, he knew why this mage needed it.

Mana affinity, something that was like gold for any mage, but it was also valuable for himself, if his mana affinity increased, first, the efficiency of his skills would increase, and second, the mana consumption of them would also decrease.
For him, who has to keep his skills fully active during battles and they also consume a lot of mana, this plant was like gold.
Finally he said.

"I will save you, either you give me the plant, or you pay three times its market price, and half of the monster’s corpse as a bonus." It was not like he could not give it up, but only if he was paid the right price for it.
The faces of all the group members turned ugly, even the healer, even the shield-bearing warrior, even the quiet swordsman, everyone knew this was practically daylight robbery.
But the worst part was that the conditions were against them, at that same moment the Lava Behemoth roared.
Its body started to shine, the cracks between its armor filled with bright red light.
"Damn it!" The mage shouted.
"Second phase!" The next second, dozens of magma balls shot in all directions.
The ground exploded, the grassland caught fire, the healer was forced to throw himself on the ground.
The shield-bearing warrior raised his shield, Rhea was thrown back several meters, but in the end none of them remained without wounds, and the battle had suddenly become more dangerous.
Much more dangerous, the lightning mage looked at Lian for a few seconds, then at the monster, and then at Lian again.
With their current situation, they had no chance of winning, in the end he gritted his teeth.
"Agreed.
"What?! Rhea turned back in disbelief.
"Agreed, three times the value of the plant, just help us kill this damn thing."
"Fine." Lian gave a small smile, he had not obtained the plant, but he was going to receive money for it at three times its market value.

Of course, if he was sure he could defeat this monster alone, there was no way he would make such an offer, he would just wait for this group to accept defeat and retreat, then he would kill the monster himself and take the plant.
But the situation was against him, even if the monster was weakened, a monster that had passed its first evolution, even if it was Normal rank, still has a berserk state.
There was no way he could defeat it in its berserk state either.
At that same moment, the Lava Behemoth opened its mouth, a massive magma ball formed, its diameter was more than three meters, and then it was fired.
The sound of the explosion echoed in the plain, the ground split, fire spread everywhere, everyone dodged, everyone except one person who had just joined the battle.
Lian... entered the field, lightning gathered on his right arm, thunder sparked between his fingers.
His muscles contracted and then... the ground beneath his feet exploded.
Not because of the monster, but because of himself, cracks spread in the soil, his body shot like a bullet, covering dozens of meters in the blink of an eye.
Everyone was stunned.
Rhea.
The shield-bearing warrior.
The healer.
The swordsman.
And even Kael.
Everyone had imagined they were dealing with a normal awakened one, in fact, only Kael had high expectations, but he thought this boy must be a mage because of the high amount of mana he had.
But this speed... this explosion... was completely unexpected.
The golden mage’s eyes widened for a moment, until a few seconds ago he thought he was the only lightning element user on the battlefield.
But now... he was seeing an unknown boy using the same element in a completely different way.
Lian pulled his fist back in mid-air, lightning gathered around his arm, the sound of thunder echoed in the air.
The Lava Behemoth had just noticed the danger, but it was too late, Lian’s fist hit the monster’s face directly.
The sound of a massive explosion echoed across the plain, the shockwave flattened the grassland.
Soil and rocks were thrown into the air, the massive body of the Lava Behemoth was pushed back several meters.
"My god... who is this guy?" Everyone’s eyes opened wide in surprise.

For a few moments everyone fell silent, even the sound of the battle seemed to stop.
"What?!
You haven’t even joined the battle yet and you are bargaining?!
Of course you are not getting anything!" Then Rhea, the red-haired girl, almost exploded.
At that same moment, the Lava Behemoth attacked with a loud roar, the shield-bearing warrior threw himself in front of the group.
The monster’s massive horn hit his shield, the sound of metal echoed across the plain, the burly man was thrown back several meters, but despite this, the argument continued.
In such an environment, this was completely normal, if someone was going to risk their life, they had to get something in return.
Lian was not a bad person, but he was also not a person who would help for free, he definitely would not let these people die, but that was the point, when should he interfere?
He could just watch for now, it was completely clear that this group was losing, and interfere after their defeat.
Or help them right now?
Lian now had the chance to examine the group members better.
The lightning mage, a boy with golden hair and green eyes, tall, calm, composed, and clearly the leader of the group.
Next to him stood the only girl in the group, a girl with fiery red hair and a huge sword that was almost twice her own size.
A bit further away was the shield-bearing warrior, a massive body, muscles like rock, and the main role of protecting the group.
The fourth warrior was a man with two short swords, fast, light, and clearly the main close-range attacker.
The last person was that thin healer boy, his face had turned white, sweat had settled on his forehead.
And he was clearly close to running out of mana.
At that moment, the lightning mage’s gaze fixed on Lian, his eyes shone for a moment, one of his innate skills had been activated, a skill that could estimate the intensity of people’s mana.
And then... his face changed, very slightly, so slightly that maybe no one would notice, but it changed, because what he had sensed was not logical.
The boy in front of him was almost the same age as himself, maybe even one or two years younger, but the amount of mana flowing in his body... was insane.
Not just more than people his age, but even more than all the members of the group, for a moment he even thought his skill had made a mistake.
But that was impossible, his skill never made mistakes.
’Who is this boy?’ For the first time, this question formed in his mind.
He had been in the Ruined Realm all this time, so he was not very aware of the country’s news, and he was not the type to follow the news either.
At that same moment, the red-haired girl attacked again, her massive sword landed on one of the monster’s legs, sparks spread, but the monster’s natural armor only got scratched.
The Lava Behemoth became angrier, magma was boiling out from the cracks in its armor.
"I will pay you half the value of the plant." The lightning mage, or in other words Kael, suddenly said.
"No." Lian shook his head without even a second of thinking.
"Then why are you still here?!" The red-haired girl, or in other words Rhea, almost exploded from anger.
"What do you want?" Kael asked calmly.
Lian did not take his gaze off the plant, he had the book of treasure, he knew exactly what this plant was, he knew why this mage needed it.

Mana affinity, something that was like gold for any mage, but it was also valuable for himself, if his mana affinity increased, first, the efficiency of his skills would increase, and second, the mana consumption of them would also decrease.
For him, who has to keep his skills fully active during battles and they also consume a lot of mana, this plant was like gold.
Finally he said.

"I will save you, either you give me the plant, or you pay three times its market price, and half of the monster’s corpse as a bonus." It was not like he could not give it up, but only if he was paid the right price for it.
The faces of all the group members turned ugly, even the healer, even the shield-bearing warrior, even the quiet swordsman, everyone knew this was practically daylight robbery.
But the worst part was that the conditions were against them, at that same moment the Lava Behemoth roared.
Its body started to shine, the cracks between its armor filled with bright red light.
"Damn it!" The mage shouted.
"Second phase!" The next second, dozens of magma balls shot in all directions.
The ground exploded, the grassland caught fire, the healer was forced to throw himself on the ground.
The shield-bearing warrior raised his shield, Rhea was thrown back several meters, but in the end none of them remained without wounds, and the battle had suddenly become more dangerous.
Much more dangerous, the lightning mage looked at Lian for a few seconds, then at the monster, and then at Lian again.
With their current situation, they had no chance of winning, in the end he gritted his teeth.
"Agreed.
"What?!
Rhea turned back in disbelief.
"Agreed, three times the value of the plant, just help us kill this damn thing."
"Fine." Lian gave a small smile, he had not obtained the plant, but he was going to receive money for it at three times its market value.

Of course, if he was sure he could defeat this monster alone, there was no way he would make such an offer, he would just wait for this group to accept defeat and retreat, then he would kill the monster himself and take the plant.
But the situation was against him, even if the monster was weakened, a monster that had passed its first evolution, even if it was Normal rank, still has a berserk state.
There was no way he could defeat it in its berserk state either.
At that same moment, the Lava Behemoth opened its mouth, a massive magma ball formed, its diameter was more than three meters, and then it was fired.
The sound of the explosion echoed in the plain, the ground split, fire spread everywhere, everyone dodged, everyone except one person who had just joined the battle.
Lian... entered the field, lightning gathered on his right arm, thunder sparked between his fingers.
His muscles contracted and then... the ground beneath his feet exploded.
Not because of the monster, but because of himself, cracks spread in the soil, his body shot like a bullet, covering dozens of meters in the blink of an eye.
Everyone was stunned.
Rhea.
The shield-bearing warrior.
The healer.
The swordsman.
And even Kael.
Everyone had imagined they were dealing with a normal awakened one, in fact, only Kael had high expectations, but he thought this boy must be a mage because of the high amount of mana he had.
But this speed... this explosion... was completely unexpected.
The golden mage’s eyes widened for a moment, until a few seconds ago he thought he was the only lightning element user on the battlefield.
But now... he was seeing an unknown boy using the same element in a completely different way.
Lian pulled his fist back in mid-air, lightning gathered around his arm, the sound of thunder echoed in the air.
The Lava Behemoth had just noticed the danger, but it was too late, Lian’s fist hit the monster’s face directly.
The sound of a massive explosion echoed across the plain, the shockwave flattened the grassland.
Soil and rocks were thrown into the air, the massive body of the Lava Behemoth was pushed back several meters.
"My god... who is this guy?" Everyone’s eyes opened wide in surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Coordination of Five
paragraphs: The sound of the explosion was still echoing in the plain.
Lian’s fist had hit the Lava Behemoth’s face like a cannonball, and for the first time in the entire battle, the massive monster had been pushed back several meters.
The tall grass around bent from the shockwave, soil and rocks scattered in the air.
And for a short moment... everyone was silent.
"Did he really punch it?!" Rhea was looking at the scene with wide eyes, she did not expect someone she thought was a freeloader to have such power.
Zak, the group’s swordsman, blinked.
"Why do I feel he dealt more damage than the mages?"
But before anyone had more time to be shocked, Kael shouted with a firm voice.
"Focus on the monster!"
At that same moment, the Lava Behemoth roared, a sound like a volcano erupting, its body moved and it stood on its feet again.
Its yellow eyes were locked on Lian, it was clear that now it had identified him as the biggest threat on the battlefield.
And the biggest threats must be eliminated first!
Lian stepped back a few steps and examined the field, he could observe the group’s fighting up close.
To be able to coordinate with the group to kill this monster, he needed to see what their main battle strategy was.
And what he saw... was not at all like temporary groups.
The group’s shield would move forward exactly when Rhea retreated, the main attacker would strike exactly when the monster’s attention was on someone else.
Elias, the group’s healer, would heal wounds without needing to be asked, and Kael controlled the entire field.
There was no extra movement, no mistakes could be seen.
With just one look, it was completely clear that this group had not just fought together for days, but for years, and they were fully aware of each other’s fighting styles.
’This level of coordination is not seen in normal groups.’ He thought to himself.
’They are probably from a professional guild.’ That was the most likely guess, and another reason that made him sure of this was that their power was not normal.
It was clear that none of them had passed their first evolution, meaning they were below level 20, yet they had the ability to fight a level 27 monster.
The monster suddenly lowered its head, and like an armored truck, it charged at the group’s shield, the ground trembled beneath its feet, and Bren, the group’s shield, immediately raised his shield.
[ Titan Wall. ]
Mana gathered around the shield, a massive semi-transparent wall formed in front of him.
The next moment... the monster’s giant horn hit it, and the sound of an explosion echoed in the plain.
The mana wall trembled but fortunately stopped it, Bren gritted his teeth, the muscles in his arms swelled.
Even for a powerful tank like him, this attack was too much, and he could barely stop it.
Then he activated his second skill.
[ Earthhold ]
His feet sank into the ground.
Mana flowed into the soil around him, his body connected to the ground, now it was almost impossible for anyone to move him, the monster’s second collision could not push him back either.
At that same moment, Rhea moved upon seeing the situation from a distance, the monster was confused and disoriented, and this was the best opportunity for a powerful attack.
Red flames twisted around her massive sword.
[ Blazing Charge ]
Her body shot forward like a fireball, her path left a trail of explosions on the ground, in the blink of an eye she appeared next to the monster’s leg.
And she brought her sword down.
[ Crimson Break ]
Dense flames exploded on the blade, the strike landed directly on the joint of the monster’s right leg, and the sound of the monster’s natural armor breaking was heard.
The monster roared, but Zak, the group’s dual-wielding attacker, did not waste the opportunity, his body faded.
[ Hidden Step ]
Suddenly he appeared behind the monster, his swords moved like a storm.
[ Hundred Cuts ]
Dozens of strikes in less than a second, sparks spread in the air and multiple wounds appeared on the monster’s back, its natural armor was slowly cracking and breaking.
He was sure that if they continued like this, they might finally be able to penetrate deeply.
He looked at their group’s healer and shouted.
"We need support!"
At that same time, Elias raised his hand, glowing flowers bloomed around the field.
[ Sacred Bloom ]
A calm green light spread over the group, Rhea’s wounds began to heal, Bren’s fatigue lessened, even Lian felt his body become lighter.
But the healer’s face became paler, the more he used support and healing skills, the more his mana was drained.
With just one look, it was clear he probably could not last more than five minutes.
But most of Lian’s attention was still on Kael, the golden-haired boy stood calmly, while everyone else was fighting, he was waiting for the right opportunity.
Then he raised his hand, thunder gathered around him, the sky darkened and suddenly...
[ Thunder Spear ]
A massive spear of lightning fell from the sky, like a meteor, like a judgment from heaven.
The spear directly hit the monster’s shoulder, the resulting explosion even forced Lian to squint his eyes.
When the smoke cleared... a large crack had been created on the monster’s armor.

"No matter how many times I see it, his control over the lightning element is unmatched." Lian watched carefully, this level of control and experience could only be gained through fighting and practice.
"But his raw power and mana are low, if it were higher, his attacks could be more devastating." Now he realized why Kael wanted that plant to increase his mana affinity.
He was looking for a way to increase his mana as quickly as possible, the most key stat for mages, although it was already high, it could go higher.
The monster attacked again, this time its mouth opened, magma gathered in its throat, but before it could fire... Lian moved.
His right hand froze, the air around him turned cold.
[ Glacial Reaper Claw ]
A massive ice claw formed on his arm, he jumped and landed the claw on the same crack in the armor.
The sound of breaking ice and armor was heard at the same time, the wound became deeper.
The monster roared in pain, and fired the magma ball wildly and without aim, the fireball came directly toward the group.
But Kael was ready.
[ Storm Prison ]
Dozens of lightning pillars fell from the sky, a network of electricity formed around the monster, its movement was stopped for a moment, creating an opportunity for Lian.
Lian, while still on the monster’s back, continued his consecutive attacks and punches, and the monster’s natural armor was breaking quickly.
The magma ball that had lost its path exploded a few meters away.
Lian was truly impressed, this damn armor was amazing, it had been able to withstand hundreds of his punches thrown with full power until now and not completely shatter.
Even the armor he himself was wearing right now did not have such resistance and would show signs of collapse with fewer punches.
But this also made him more excited, such skin could be sold for much more than normal.
Now it was time to finish it, lightning gathered on his fists, the air began to tremble.
[ Thunder Calamity ]
Each fist acted like a thunder explosion, the monster’s armor, which had barely held on until now, started cracking one after another.
Then he prepared the final attack, his entire body filled with mana, the ground beneath his feet trembled, and he thrust his hand forward.
[ Cataclysm Pulse ]
A massive shockwave was released, as if the entire space had exploded, the massive body of the Lava Behemoth was thrown back.
And the monster finally showed signs of wavering.
"It’s falling!" Rhea laughed.
"Just a little more!" Bren shouted.
Even Kael smiled briefly, victory seemed near, finally they could see victory close.
Finally he could obtain that plant.
But... at that very moment.
Suddenly, a notification appeared for all of them.
The Lava Behemoth’s body began to tremble, all smiles faded, the wounds that had just been created began to close.
Magma burst out from the cracks in its armor, its height increased, its muscles swelled, its massive horn turned bright red.
And a wave of pressure spread across the entire plain.
[ The Monster has entered Berserk state ]
[ All stats Increased ]
[ Pain Suppression Enabled ]
Kael’s face changed, for the first time his calmness broke, Rhea cursed under her breath, Bren unconsciously stepped back, even Zak lost his smile.
"Berserk state? Why the hell does this damn thing have a berserk state!"
"Damn it, how are we supposed to defeat it now that it’s even stronger!"
"At this rate, if we don’t run, we might die!"
"Idiot, you want to run? The plant is right here! Brother Kael needs it! We have to get it no matter what!"
"In exchange for our lives? Are you serious? We can always find another one!"
The monster raised its head and roared, its roar sounded like a volcanic mountain exploding.
[ Molten Armor ]
Magma flowed over its natural armor and covered its entire body, now every close-range strike could burn the attacker.
[ Volcanic Rupture ]
The ground around it cracked.
Dozens of magma pillars erupted from the soil, the entire plain turned into a field of death.
The monster’s eyes were completely red, no rationality could be seen in them anymore... only rage, only killing.
"Well, I have to say I expected this." Lian felt that this fight might be much harder than he had imagined, but he had expected the berserk state beforehand.

chapters.title: Chapter 138: The Aftermath
paragraphs: The roar of the Lava Behemoth echoed across the entire plain.
A wave of magma burst out from the cracks between its natural armor and turned the surrounding grass into ash within seconds.
The monster’s yellow eyes were now completely red, no trace of rationality could be seen in its gaze, only rage, only destruction.

This was the berserk state! A state that only activated when monsters reached below 10 percent of their remaining health, a state in which all the monster’s stats increase for a short time and it acts like a mindless creature and a killing machine to survive.
Not every monster has such a state, especially among normal rank monsters it is very rare, even fallen monsters that are below level 20 rarely have such a state.
Some normal monsters after their first evolution might be lucky enough to obtain such a state as their last layer of survival.
These monsters are sometimes among the strongest of their own kind, or are leaders of their herds, or are so confident that they act and live alone.
Lian knew from the information he had obtained in high school that this monster most likely had a berserk state.
And right at that moment, the ground beneath everyone’s feet began to shake.
[ Magma Domain Activated ]
Red cracks spread like veins of fire across the entire plain.
The heat rose quickly, the air became heavy, even breathing had become harder.

Lian frowned, this was the second time he was facing a real berserk monster, the first time was against the Dreadmaw, but at that time that Unholy had only gone crazy because its plans had been disrupted.
And the difference from the Dreadmaw was completely clear, this monster had entered this state to survive and save itself.
The psychological pressure of such a creature could not be recreated by any simulation.
The Lava Behemoth suddenly lowered its head, its massive muscles contracted, and then it shot forward like an armored train.
[ Infernal Charge ]
"Bren!" Rhea’s face turned pale and she shouted.
The shield-bearing warrior did not step back even one step, he raised his shield, mana flowed through his entire body.
[ Fortress Heart ]
Golden veins appeared on his skin, his body looked like a stone fortress.

The next moment the collision happened, a massive explosion sound echoed in the plain, Bren was dragged several meters on the ground, blood came out from the corner of his lips, he felt his ribs and bones shatter.
Blood splattered from his ears and eyes, and he started coughing up blood.
But... he had stopped it, although he had paid a terrible price.
"Now!" Kael’s shout echoed across the field.
Zak disappeared.
[ Hidden Step ]
And appeared behind the monster, his sword flashed, but this time he did not use his previous skill, he just created a deep cut on the monster’s tendon.
Precise, fast, but not deadly, the monster’s defense was stronger than before, and dealing damage to it was even harder.
At the same time, Rhea attacked from the left.
[ Blazing Charge ]
Her body turned into a ball of fire, her massive sword landed on the monster’s armor, sparks and flames spread in the air.
She put all her power into that strike to at least deal some damage, but the monster was still standing.

Lian took a quiet breath, then lightning gathered on his arm, clearly he himself had to act again, he had the highest strength among all of them, and he was the only one who could break this monster’s defense.
[ Thunder Calamity ]
He lunged forward, his fist hit the monster’s side, an explosion of thunder spread through the massive creature’s body.
For a moment its muscles contracted.
In the distance, Kael raised his hand, thunder clouds were slowly forming in the sky, but the time to use his main spell had not yet come.
The monster roared again, this time it raised its head toward the sky, magma gathered in its mouth, but instead of firing directly... it threw it upward.
[ Lava Rain ]
Hundreds of pieces of molten rock appeared in the sky, and then fell to the ground like rain of death.
"Spread out!"
Kael shouted.
Everyone was forced to change their positions, but it was not enough, there were hundreds of magma rocks, Zak and Rhea quickly moved toward Bren and took cover beside him.
Lian activated [ Diamond Skin ] and a protective layer covered his entire body, the small rocks that hit him could not pass through his defense.
But one of the large rocks landed next to Lian, the resulting explosion created a crater several meters wide, and its shockwave even caused his skin to burn.
If it had hit directly... even he would have taken serious damage.
Elias, seeing that the rocks were falling toward him, became terrified, he felt this might be the last moments of his life.
He had nothing to protect himself... was he going to die here?
[ Branches of Thunder ]
Suddenly dozens of lightning bolts struck from the sky and turned all the magma rocks to ash... especially the one that was about to fall on Elias’s head.
"Th-thank... thank you so much, captain." The healer thanked him sincerely upon seeing that Kael had saved him.
"Get back to your positions, we will proceed with the swarm attack." Kael nodded and then shouted.
The group members scattered and positioned themselves in different spots.
Lian, amid the battle, kept observing them, the more he looked, the more sure he became.
This group was professional, not just strong, but professional, their movements were trained, and his guess that they were a trained group became more certain.
The battle continued, minutes passed one after another, the monster took more wounds, but the group also became more tired.
At one moment, the Lava Behemoth lifted its foot and intended to stomp it on Rhea.
But Zak suddenly disappeared.
[ Shadow Sever ]
He appeared directly behind the monster’s neck, his sword landed on one of the old wounds, the monster was distracted by the pain.
And Rhea survived.
The right time had finally come, finally enough mana had been gathered, Kael closed his eyes, mana gathered around him like a storm, dark clouds covered the entire sky.
The sound of thunder could be heard in the distance.
"This spell..." Lian watched this spell being cast with interest, he was sure, this amount of mana, such power... this was a skill with Holy rank!
Kael raised his hand.
[ Heavenly Thunderfall ]
The sky exploded, dozens of massive lightning bolts fell toward the ground, all of them on one point, all of them on the Lava Behemoth.
The resulting explosion swallowed the twilight light, for a few seconds no one could see anything.
"Rhea!"
The red-haired girl smiled, all her mana gathered on her sword.
[ Scarlet Execution ]
Red flames spun around the blade, she rushed toward the monster like a meteor.
At that same moment, Lian also moved, lightning gathered on his right arm and ice claws appeared again.
Then without stopping...
[ Cataclysm Pulse ]
A massive shockwave was released.
Rhea’s strike... Lian’s strike and Kael’s rain of thunder, all of them hit the target almost simultaneously.
For a moment time stopped, the massive body of the Lava Behemoth trembled.
It took one step back... then a second step, its massive horn broke, and finally... it fell.
The plain ground, which had mostly turned into a lava and magma ruin, trembled.
"Did we succeed...?"
And silence returned.
A few seconds later, the system notification appeared.
[ Lava Behemoth level 27 killed ]
[ Contribution Calculated ]
[ Group Kill Penalty Applied ]
[ EXP Acquired ]
[ Stat Points Gained: +9 ]
[ You have obtained a skill ]

Nine stats, just from one monster, but for a level 27 monster it was low, if it was not a group kill, he should have gotten 18 stats.
He calculated in his mind.
If he could repeat hunts at this level alone, his growth would be much faster than he imagined.
But for now, he was far from that level of power, although he might reach it soon.
Then he looked at his level, he had not leveled up, but he was not far off, the EXP bar was almost full.
Then he noticed that he had obtained a new skill, in fact, today he had also obtained two other skills from killing other monsters, but he had not had the chance to look at them.
He looked at the group, the four of them were lying on the ground like dead people and clearly needed to rest.
The golden plant was still shining in the center of the plain, maybe the only thing that had remained intact because the monster itself did not want to damage it.
"Thank you for your help, without you we would not have had a chance to defeat it." Kael came forward and added.
"According to the agreement, I will pay you three times the market price for the plant." Kael came forward.
"I still think you are robbing us." Rhea’s face immediately turned ugly.
"But your captain agreed, and without me you would have been dead." Lian shrugged.
Rhea had nothing to say, and that made her even angrier.
The rest of the group was also not happy, but they still thanked him for helping them, they were not foolish enough to think they had a chance alone.

The plant for Kael, three times the market price for Lian, half of the monster’s corpse for Lian.
And the other half for the group.

"How do I know you will send the money?"
"Because I am the son of Ariana Westwood, that should give my identity credibility, right?" A few seconds of silence followed, then Kael said calmly.
Lian was silent for a moment.
Ariana Westwood, the leader of one of the country’s largest guilds, one of the most powerful women in the country.
A woman whose name had been seen many times in the news, but mostly because of the controversies surrounding her.
Because she was a woman who had never married, but had a son, and no one knew who the father of her son was.
Unconsciously, he looked at Kael’s face, then the image of the President appeared in his mind.
Golden hair, green eyes, face shape, their resemblance was really strange.
’At this point I would be an idiot if I thought the resemblance was a coincidence.’ He chuckled to himself.
After they exchanged contact information in case any problem occurred with the payment, he finally separated from the group, the sun had almost completely set.
Lian mounted the Windrunner Strider, today was only supposed to be a simple patrol.
But at the end of the day, he had hunted several monsters, acquired half the corpse of a level 27 monster.
And he was going to receive several million dollars too.
"Not bad." A small smile appeared on his face.
"For the first day back, it really was not bad." As the lights of the base appeared in the distance, Lian looked at the dark sky.
Today was only supposed to be a simple patrol, but the profit he had gained... was much more than he had expected.

sentences.text: The roar of the Lava Behemoth echoed across the entire plain.
A wave of magma burst out from the cracks between its natural armor and turned the surrounding grass into ash within seconds.
The monster’s yellow eyes were now completely red, no trace of rationality could be seen in its gaze, only rage, only destruction.
This was the berserk state!

A state that only activated when monsters reached below 10 percent of their remaining health, a state in which all the monster’s stats increase for a short time and it acts like a mindless creature and a killing machine to survive.
Not every monster has such a state, especially among normal rank monsters it is very rare, even fallen monsters that are below level 20 rarely have such a state.
Some normal monsters after their first evolution might be lucky enough to obtain such a state as their last layer of survival.
These monsters are sometimes among the strongest of their own kind, or are leaders of their herds, or are so confident that they act and live alone.

Red cracks spread like veins of fire across the entire plain.
The heat rose quickly, the air became heavy, even breathing had become harder.

Lian frowned, this was the second time he was facing a real berserk monster, the first time was against the Dreadmaw, but at that time that Unholy had only gone crazy because its plans had been disrupted.
And the difference from the Dreadmaw was completely clear, this monster had entered this state to survive and save itself.
The psychological pressure of such a creature could not be recreated by any simulation.
The Lava Behemoth suddenly lowered its head, its massive muscles contracted, and then it shot forward like an armored train.
[ Infernal Charge ]
"Bren!" Rhea’s face turned pale and she shouted.
The shield-bearing warrior did not step back even one step, he raised his shield, mana flowed through his entire body.
[ Fortress Heart ]
Golden veins appeared on his skin, his body looked like a stone fortress.

The next moment the collision happened, a massive explosion sound echoed in the plain, Bren was dragged several meters on the ground, blood came out from the corner of his lips, he felt his ribs and bones shatter.
Blood splattered from his ears and eyes, and he started coughing up blood.
But... he had stopped it, although he had paid a terrible price.
"Now!" Kael’s shout echoed across the field.
Zak disappeared.
[ Hidden Step ]
And appeared behind the monster, his sword flashed, but this time he did not use his previous skill, he just created a deep cut on the monster’s tendon.
Precise, fast, but not deadly, the monster’s defense was stronger than before, and dealing damage to it was even harder.
At the same time, Rhea attacked from the left.
[ Blazing Charge ]
Her body turned into a ball of fire, her massive sword landed on the monster’s armor, sparks and flames spread in the air.
She put all her power into that strike to at least deal some damage, but the monster was still standing.

Lian took a quiet breath, then lightning gathered on his arm, clearly he himself had to act again, he had the highest strength among all of them, and he was the only one who could break this monster’s defense.
[ Thunder Calamity ]
He lunged forward, his fist hit the monster’s side, an explosion of thunder spread through the massive creature’s body.
For a moment its muscles contracted.
In the distance, Kael raised his hand, thunder clouds were slowly forming in the sky, but the time to use his main spell had not yet come.
The monster roared again, this time it raised its head toward the sky, magma gathered in its mouth, but instead of firing directly... it threw it upward.
[ Lava Rain ]
Hundreds of pieces of molten rock appeared in the sky, and then fell to the ground like rain of death.
"Spread out!"
Kael shouted.
Everyone was forced to change their positions, but it was not enough, there were hundreds of magma rocks, Zak and Rhea quickly moved toward Bren and took cover beside him.
Lian activated [ Diamond Skin ] and a protective layer covered his entire body, the small rocks that hit him could not pass through his defense.
But one of the large rocks landed next to Lian, the resulting explosion created a crater several meters wide, and its shockwave even caused his skin to burn.
If it had hit directly... even he would have taken serious damage.
Elias, seeing that the rocks were falling toward him, became terrified, he felt this might be the last moments of his life.
He had nothing to protect himself... was he going to die here?
[ Branches of Thunder ]
Suddenly dozens of lightning bolts struck from the sky and turned all the magma rocks to ash... especially the one that was about to fall on Elias’s head.
"Th-thank... thank you so much, captain." The healer thanked him sincerely upon seeing that Kael had saved him.

The group members scattered and positioned themselves in different spots.
Lian, amid the battle, kept observing them, the more he looked, the more sure he became.
This group was professional, not just strong, but professional, their movements were trained, and his guess that they were a trained group became more certain.

chapters.title: Chapter 139: New Armor!
paragraphs: After returning to the base, Lian went straight to the accommodation section.
As he walked through the busy streets, he realized more and more why they called this place a city.
This was a real city, a city built in the heart of the Ruined Realm.
On both sides of the streets were stores, blacksmith workshops, medical centers, guild offices, and various buildings.
Some hunters had just returned from missions and blood from monsters could still be seen on their armors.
Others were preparing to leave, he even saw a few people directly trading monster materials on the side of the street.

It had exactly the same feeling as normal cities outside this place, it was amazing that the government had been able to build such a thing within a few weeks, of course, after two centuries, naturally they have a lot of experience.
After a little searching, he finally entered one of the largest accommodation complexes in the base.
There were several types of accommodation here, cheap rooms for students.
Group dormitories, suites for guilds, and luxury accommodations for high-level hunters.
Lian chose neither the cheapest option nor the most expensive, he just took a suitable private room, a place where he could rest whenever he returned to the base.
Even next to the building there was a stable for riding monsters, and the Windrunner Strider received its own dedicated space.
After that, he finally went to his room and spent a quiet night.

Half the corpse of the Lava Behemoth, the corpses of the monsters he had hunted during the day, new stats he had obtained, and three new skills, one from the Lava Behemoth and two others from the monsters he had hunted during the day, he reviewed everything once.
Now that he was free, he wanted to look at his skills.
[ Name: Molten Armor ]
[ Rank: Common ( + ) ]

[ Description: Creates a layer of magma armor on the user’s body, physical defense increases by up to 250%, converts a portion of incoming damage into heat damage and returns it to the enemy, enemies who come into direct contact with the user suffer burns. Consumes 3 units of mana per minute. ]
His eyes sparkled, he had not expected to obtain a new defensive skill, he already has Diamond Skin right now, of course, it has reached its peak potential and is not useful against strong enemies.
But now he finally obtained a new powerful defensive skill, one whose base rank gives 250% defense! With many other capabilities.
If the Common rank is like this, how much more powerful will it become when he upgrades it?
Although its mana consumption was terribly high.
Then he looked at the next skill.
[ Name: Night Eyes ]
[ Rank: Common ]
[ Description: Night vision skill, your eyes can see at night as well as during the day, also all six senses become 50% stronger at night. Consumes 0.1 units of mana per minute. ]
He looked up, at first glance it was not that special, but it could be a great help in night hunting, now he no longer had to give up hunting at night just because of the darkness.
With the small boost it gives, his senses will work better and stronger at night.
"Of course, the skill has no upgrade option, so its potential is only this much."
Then he looked at the third skill.
[ Name: Poison Bane ]
[ Rank: Common ( + ) ]
[ Description: Increases resistance to all poisons by 20%. ]
"This can also be useful." He pondered for a moment, resistance to poisons seems worthless at first glance, but that is not the case.
The Ruined Realm has many poisonous monsters, even within this 300 kilometer radius of the base, there are many poisonous plant monsters.
And poison itself can be a silent killer.
Then he closed the panel, fell on the bed, and peacefully fell asleep.
The next morning.
After a simple breakfast, Lian was ready to leave.
But before reaching the base gates, he noticed that the atmosphere around was different from yesterday.
The crowd was larger than usual, hundreds of people had gathered around the mission boards.
Students, independent hunters, mercenary groups, guild members, even a few high-level figures whose presence alone attracted a lot of attention.
Lian became curious and went toward the crowd, when he got close to the board, he understood the reason for this commotion.
On the largest holographic screen of the base, a red notification could be seen.
[ Emergency Extermination Mission ]
[ Target Species: Ironfang Ravagers ]
Lian’s eyes moved over the displayed information.
Ironfang Ravagers were creatures similar to monitor lizards.

But several times larger, each one reaching two and a half meters in height, their bodies covered with natural metal plates, they had dark gray teeth harder than steel, their skin was blue and highly poisonous, a liquid oozed from their bodies that was terribly toxic and deadly.
They hunted in packs, were very fast, and notoriously aggressive.
But their biggest problem was their numbers, according to the displayed information, within just the last two weeks, the population of this race had increased explosively.
They had attacked caravans.
They had destroyed several exploration groups and were responsible for the deaths of hundreds of awakened ones.
They were one of the three monster races that had stopped the awakened ones from advancing beyond a hundred kilometers.
At that moment, the mission reward information appeared.
The crowd’s murmur grew louder.
For many hunters, such a figure could change their lives.
But Lian showed almost no reaction. After selling various assets and his recent loot, he had over two hundred and twenty million dollars at his disposal.
He had spent one million on the Windrunner Strider and his wealth had still not changed noticeably.
Thirty million dollars was a large number, but not large enough to excite him, what had caught his attention were the monsters themselves.

If the government had decided to wipe out an entire race, then there were hundreds of monsters, hundreds of sources of experience, hundreds of sources of stats, and hundreds of sources of valuable materials.
This mission looked more like a huge growth farm than a job.
A few hunters next to him were discussing, Lian listened to their conversation without drawing attention.

The government usually did not directly interfere in hunting monsters, but this time the situation was different, three monster races within a hundred to four hundred kilometer radius of the base had reached dangerous levels.
Ironfang Ravagers were only the first target.
After that, the other two races would probably also be wiped out, this made Lian understand that something bigger was forming, and probably new opportunities.
However, he did not accept the mission, at least not for now, his information was not enough, besides, the assault operation was scheduled for tomorrow and not today.
And there was no limit on the number of participants.
So he decided to continue his original plan today.
Patrol, reconnaissance and information gathering, and of course, advancing to a 400 kilometer radius. A few minutes later, he mounted the Windrunner Strider again and left the base.
This time he changed his route, instead of the familiar and crowded areas, he went toward the border of the explored zones.
The further he went, the fewer hunters there were, the marked roads disappeared, and nature became wilder.
Along the way he hunted a few weak monsters, but they were between levels 4 and 5, he found a few valuable C and B rank plants with the help of the book.
Everything was going as expected.
Until a few hours later, when he reached near an area where one of the Ironfang Ravagers’ lairs was suspected to be located.
His distance from the base had reached approximately four hundred kilometers, his main goal was still not to engage them, he just wanted to take a look from a distance.
Check their numbers, hunt a few samples, and get familiar with their real power.
But right at that moment, something happened that changed all his plans.
The book of treasure suddenly trembled violently, stronger than ever before, stronger than when he had found the Sunheart Bloom.
The golden pages opened without his intervention, golden light burst out from them and the 3D map appeared, Lian immediately noticed that something was different.
This time there was no blue point, not even a golden point, for the first time... a red-black point had appeared on the map.
The notification immediately appeared.
[ Warning ]
A few seconds later, the second notification appeared.
[ Unknown Treasure Detected ]
[ Threat Level: High! ]
[ Danger Assessment Failed ]
Lian’s eyes narrowed, this was unusual, very unusual, the book of treasure had always been able to identify the type of treasure until today.
It had always assessed the threat level, but this time... it had failed.
Even the type of treasure was not identified, the only explanation the book provided was that for complete identification, he had to touch that object.
This, instead of calming him, multiplied his curiosity several times.
At that same moment, the sound of a deep roar echoed in the distance, a sound so heavy that it even shook the air.
Lian raised his head, this was not the sound of a normal monster, the Windrunner Strider suddenly stopped.
All its muscles stiffened, its body trembled... it was scared.
Lian stared at the horizon, somewhere beyond his direct sight, somewhere near that same red-black point... there was something, something that even the book of treasure had not been able to identify.
And at that same moment, a thought crossed his mind, what was hidden there might be much more valuable than the Sunheart Bloom.
And that thought was enough for him to definitely go and find it...
