Lian stared at the horizon, somewhere beyond his direct sight, somewhere near that same red-black point... there was something, something that even the book of treasure had not been able to identify.
And at that same moment, a thought crossed his mind, what was hidden there might be much more valuable than the Sunheart Bloom.
And that thought was enough for him to definitely go and find it...

chapters.title: Chapter 140: The Treasure Under the River
paragraphs: Lian reduced the speed of the Windrunner Strider, the closer he got to the point the book of treasure was showing, the stronger a strange feeling became inside him.
The book was still open, its golden pages were glowing softly, and the red-black point on the map was getting darker moment by moment.
And curiosity grew more and more inside him, what could it be?
What could cause such a reaction from the book?
At the same time, the sound of roars could be heard from a distance, at first he thought there were only one or two monsters.
It was not unusual, in the Ruined Realm, the roaring of monsters was almost considered a part of nature.
But the further he went, the more the sounds increased, roar after roar, harsh screams, the sound of metal hitting metal.

The sound of breaking rocks, and he soon realized he had been mistaken, this was not the sound of a few monsters, something much bigger was waiting for him, and instead of moving directly, he changed his path.
He passed through the rocks, climbed the high slopes, and tried to get close to the area without attracting attention.
He did not know what he was going to face, the threat level of the book of treasure had shown that it was very high, and he takes such warnings seriously.
Especially when yesterday the Medium threat warning was a level 27 monster that even had a berserk state.
So God knew how dangerous a High threat level really was, definitely at a level where he would have no chance of winning alone.
A few minutes later, he finally reached a point where he had a good view of the surroundings, when he looked down from the edge of the cliff, for a moment he was truly silent.
At the bottom of the valley, a massive river was flowing, its width maybe reaching a hundred meters, its dark and deep water was moving at high speed.
But what really caught the attention was not the river.
But its two sides.
Hundreds of nests, hundreds of caves, dozens of natural tunnels, rocks that had been perforated by digging, and among all of them...
Ironfang Ravagers.
Everywhere he looked, monsters could be seen, some were resting, some were eating the carcasses of their prey, and some were fighting each other.
And some were just wandering around the river.
It took Lian a few seconds to understand their real numbers, with just one look he could see hundreds of monsters.
Hundreds.
This number alone was enough to force any sensible hunter to retreat.
But the matter did not end there, when he focused on some of them, system notifications appeared.
[ Ironfang Ravager ]
[ Rank: Normal ]
[ Level 25 ]
[ Ironfang Ravager ]
[ Rank: Normal ]
[ Level 27 ]
[ Ironfang Ravager ]
[ Rank: Normal ]
[ Level 29 ]
[ Ironfang Ravager ]
[ Rank: Normal ]
[ Level 30 ]
Lian’s eyes narrowed, dozens of monsters were in this same area, dozens of creatures whose levels were between twenty-five and thirty.
He understood at that moment why the government had personally gotten involved, this was no longer a herd, it was an army.
Even with his current power, facing such a number of high-level monsters was impossible.
Maybe he could kill one, but he had no chance against two, let alone more, when dozens of monsters attacked at the same time, the result was already clear.
Even with Kael’s group’s help, they would have no chance here, if they were lucky, they might be able to escape alive.
Then he saw something that made the situation seem even more dangerous than he had imagined.
A few larger creatures, much larger, some of them were five meters tall, some even close to six meters, their bodies covered with black-gold plates.
Their horns were bigger, their claws thicker and sharper, and their presence was clearly heavier than the other members of the herd.
The system notification appeared.
[ Ironfang Ravager ]
[ Rank: Fallen ]
[ Level 23 ]
Lian stared at them without moving for a few seconds.
This was the first time he was seeing several Fallen ones in one place, until today Fallen ones had always been rare creatures.
Even in Frostfallen city there was only one of them, although he is much stronger now, here there were several of them present.
And this matter alone was enough to multiply the danger level of the area several times.
"I have no chance against these, and the book announced the threat level as High?
So what would an Impossible threat level be?"
he whispered to himself.
Before coming here, he thought maybe there would be a few monsters above level 25, but this situation is much worse and more extreme than what he expected.
But still, the most important part of the story was something else.
The book of treasure, all this time the book was still pointing to the river, not to the monsters, not to the nests, not to the Fallen ones, but to the river itself.
What could be in that river that the book valued so highly?
Lian examined the environment for a full few minutes, then finally he saw something.
In the depths of the water, at a point near the center of the river, a faint red light could be seen, at first he thought it was a reflection of sunlight.
But no, the light was not constant, it pulsed every few seconds, like a heartbeat, like something alive, like something waiting to awaken.
Lian took a deep breath and started analyzing the situation.
First, the treasure was at the bottom of the river.
Second, the monsters had gathered around it in an unusual way.
Third, if he acted himself, his chance of death was extremely high.
Even if he managed to kill a few monsters, in the end he would be surrounded by hundreds of monsters.
And this time, even Shadow Skin could not help him, that skill performed excellently against weaker monsters.
But against this number of powerful monsters?
It was not enough at all, he could upgrade it, but it would still not be effective.
He had to consider the risk that there might be a much greater threat to his life inside that river itself, which Shadow Skin had no immunity against.
He was silent for a few minutes.
Then, instead of thinking about a direct attack, his mind went toward a much more logical option.
Using others, the government, guilds, hunters, students, all of them would come here sooner or later, all of them were supposed to attack this nest.
So why should he risk his own life?
They would clear the path, kill the monsters, and he would go straight for the treasure.
It was not a bad idea, in fact it was a great idea, he could also kill a significant number of monsters during that time and obtain extra stats too.
In fact, if he could even kill these Fallen ones with the help of groups, the exp gained should still be enough for him to reach level 15.
But right when he was about to turn back, something else caught his attention.
He followed the path of the river, and realized this nest was not alone, a few kilometers further, another nest could be seen, and a little further from that... a third nest.
Both belonged to different races, the first were creatures like massive armored snakes, their bodies covered with metal spikes.
Every now and then, sparks of lightning passed through the spikes, as if their own bodies were producing electrical energy.
The second were creatures like black crocodiles, but large metal horns had grown on their heads, and from those horns, waves of unknown energy were emitted.
All three nests were located along this same river, all three races had gathered around this same area, and all three seemed unusually powerful.
"So everything starts from this river... whatever is inside it must definitely be important to these monsters," Lian said softly under his breath.
The fact that three different races had built nests next to one river showed that that river was hiding something very important.
Normally, different monsters cannot live together and tolerate each other at all, unless a powerful leader forces them to submit.
Whatever was buried there, its value was much greater than what he had imagined.
He gave one last look at the river, the book of treasure was still warning.
[ Unknown Treasure Detected ]
But this time a new notification appeared.
[ Estimated Distance: 417 meters ]
Lian was silent for a moment.
Only four hundred and seventeen meters, the treasure was almost right under the noses of those monsters, a small smile appeared on his face.
"Good... let them open the rest of the way for me."
Then he pulled the reins of the Windrunner Strider, the riding monster immediately changed its direction.
Lian calmly moved away from the rock, but in his mind there was now only one goal.
Obtaining what even the book of treasures had not been able to identify.
And this goal would be achieved tomorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Before Operation ...
paragraphs: When Lian returned from the river area, the sky had become completely dark.
The magical lights of the base had turned on one after another, and the massive base looked like a shining city in the middle of the darkness of the Ruined Realm.
But unlike the day before, this time he did not go straight to his accommodation, the treasure that the book had shown was still occupying his mind.
The river, the three monster races, and that unknown object that even the book of treasure had not been able to identify.
If he wanted to get close to it, first of all he needed information, and information was as valuable as power.
So he changed his path toward the base’s information and archive building, the archive building was located in the center of the government section of the base.
A multi-story building with thick metal walls and dozens of holographic screens that constantly displayed new data.
When he entered, he saw several hunters and students who were searching for information about monsters and different areas.

It seemed he was not the only one who gathered information before doing something, there were other awakened ones who were willing to spend extra time to get information about monsters to protect their safety and lives.
Lian chose one of the terminals and started searching in the holographic systems.
The first name he entered was Ironfang Ravagers.
Immediately dozens of files appeared, maps, hunting reports, casualty statistics, behavioral patterns.
All of this was information that had been obtained over the past few weeks through continuous encounters.
After a few minutes of studying, he realized that what he had seen was even more dangerous than he had imagined.
The population of this race had increased by almost 40 percent over the past few weeks, this rate was unusual and unbelievable, such a growth rate had never been seen before.
Even if they spent every day reproducing, their population should not have grown this much in just a few weeks.
Their attacks on awakened ones had increased, and several exploration groups had been completely destroyed by them.
Hundreds of awakened ones had been killed by them, they never moved alone and were always in groups of ten.
For this reason, hunting them was almost impossible for low-level awakened ones, even Lian could not defeat a group of them.
But what caught his attention more was their habitat, all reports pointed to one common area.
The river, the same river he himself had seen.
Then he went to the second race, the armored lightning serpents.
Thunder Spine Serpents.
Creatures whose bodies were covered with metal spikes and naturally produced electrical currents.
Extremely aggressive monsters, highly territorial, and almost incapable of coexisting with other species, but again their habitat... was the same river.
What was even more interesting was that their population had also increased by 40 percent over the few weeks they had been identified.
Lian frowned, another strange population increase.
Then he went to the third race.
Ironhorn Marsh Drakes.
Massive black crocodiles with metal horns that emitted mysterious energy.
They were also highly aggressive, and according to all reports, they should have been in constant war with the other two races.
But they were not, all three races lived in one area, without destroying each other, without large-scale conflicts, and this was not normal at all.
And they had also experienced a 40 percent population increase.
Lian leaned back in his chair, in the entire history of the Ruined Realms, monster races rarely lived together.
Unless... there was something that kept them together, something whose value was greater than territory and hunting instincts.
Something that all those monsters unconsciously protected.
And the more he thought, the more sure he became that the answer was hidden in that same river.
When he left the archive building, he finally had a chance to walk through the base streets and noticed that the atmosphere of the base had completely changed compared to yesterday.
Everyone was talking about one topic.
The cleansing operation, groups were forming, new notifications were constantly appearing on the holographic screens.
The names of several big guilds of the country were heard in almost all the discussions.
Phoenix Crown guild.
Silver Vanguard guild.
Black Horizon guild.
And even several famous independent groups had also joined the operation, the thirty million dollar reward had made almost half of the base talk about this mission.
But money was not the only reason for people’s excitement, after the destruction of these three races, the areas beyond the current radius would become accessible again.
Unknown areas, new resources, undiscovered ruins, and possibly valuable treasures, even if they were lucky they could find hidden areas and traces left from the past civilizations of this world.
Each of these opportunities could make them stronger, richer, more famous, and more popular.
For many hunters, this operation was actually the gateway to bigger opportunities.
Lian was walking among the crowd when suddenly something came to his mind.
Kain, he immediately went to the registration section and checked his status.
The result had not changed.
Last sighting: six days ago.
Registered location: unknown area.
There was no new report, no check-in, no return.
Lian stared at the screen for a few moments, then sighed.
"He still has not returned..." In the end he closed the system and headed back to the exit, hoping nothing had happened to his friend.

Because that boy was the type of excited awakened one who might do very dangerous things, and Kain, feeling that he might fall behind him and Seraphina, might want to take risks to become stronger and catch up to them.
After leaving, on his way back to his accommodation, he heard a voice.
"I did not think I would see you again."
Lian turned around.
Kael, the lightning mage from yesterday’s group, today was wearing normal clothes and there was no sign of the bloody battle from yesterday on his face.
"Me neither, it looks like you have fully recovered and are on your feet." Lian gave a short smile.
"Thanks to you." Kael laughed and then continued.
"By the way, the money has been transferred."
"I have not left the realm yet to check my account, but thank you."
"We should be the ones thanking you, if you had not arrived there, probably none of us would be here today." Kael shook his head.
A few minutes were spent talking about yesterday’s battle.
During the conversation, Lian found out that Kael’s group was also going to participate in the cleansing operation and apparently they had prepared for it.
"Are you very sure the operation will go well?" Kael said calmly.
"It is natural, if everything goes well, there is a high chance I will reach level twenty." His eyes sparkled for a moment.
"And finally get my first evolution quest."
Lian unconsciously thought about his own level, Level 13, unless he personally slaughtered all three races, it was unlikely he would go beyond level 15 tomorrow.
The gap between levels became larger the higher they went, and for him this matter was even worse than for other awakened ones.
But he was a little curious to know what his first evolution quest would be.
"Soon the ranking of the base’s best hunters will also be launched, I want to be the first place, and tomorrow’s assault will be a help." Kael continued.
"Ranking?" This time Lian’s attention was truly caught.
"Yeah."

"A new system, points based on missions, hunts, contributions, and achievements, the top five ranks monthly receive rewards, and apparently in the future, if the federation discovers hidden areas or special areas and gives quotas to each country, the quotas will be chosen from the top ranks of the base... I think it will be an interesting competition."

Lian did not say anything, but his mind was engaged, the first place of the Base, it was not a bad title, but it would make him more famous than before, although if the talk about quotas was true, he might have no choice.

After that, the discussion continued for a while, Kael tried to recruit him to be with them in the assault, even though the entire group did not like Lian, as the captain he believed having such a warrior with them was very good.
But Lian refused, if he became a member of a group, he would lose his freedom and tomorrow he would not be able to do what he wanted, so he preferred to advance alone.
Kael did not insist too much, and after saying goodbye, Lian returned to his room.
He took a shower, checked his equipment, and fell asleep without thinking about the treasure or the monsters.
The next morning.
The base had exploded, at least in terms of population, when he left the accommodation building, he saw thousands of people preparing.
Hunters, students, guild members, mercenary groups, and even independent awakened ones who had come just for this operation.
Lian had also registered his name in the operation list yesterday.
So he went to the gathering point, when he arrived there, for the first time he realized how many powerful awakened ones were present at the base.

Dozens above level twenty, several above level thirty, and right in the center of the crowd... a woman in black armor was standing, the aura she was emitting was more commanding and stronger than everyone around her.
The woman stepped forward a few steps and her voice was calm but powerful.
"Today is not a joke, this operation is dangerous, anyone who thinks they came for excitement, it is better to turn back right now."
The crowd fell silent, and she continued.
"We are entering the territory of a monster race, they will defend their home, and they will have no hesitation in killing you."
"So be careful, do not leave your group, and if things get bad, running away is better than dying."
A heavy silence fell, and then the woman raised her hand and gave the signal.
"We move."
A few seconds later, a massive wave of awakened ones left the base.
Hundreds of riding monsters, hundreds of people on foot, and dozens of powerful groups, all moving toward the Ironfang Ravagers’ lair.
Lian also mounted the Windrunner Strider and moved among this massive army.
No one knew what was waiting for them, no one knew what was hidden in the depths of that river.
And no one knew that today’s cleansing operation... was going to be their biggest mistake.

Lian unconsciously thought about his own level, Level 13, unless he personally slaughtered all three races, it was unlikely he would go beyond level 15 tomorrow.
The gap between levels became larger the higher they went, and for him this matter was even worse than for other awakened ones.
But he was a little curious to know what his first evolution quest would be.
"Soon the ranking of the base’s best hunters will also be launched, I want to be the first place, and tomorrow’s assault will be a help." Kael continued.
"Ranking?" This time Lian’s attention was truly caught.
"Yeah."

"A new system, points based on missions, hunts, contributions, and achievements, the top five ranks monthly receive rewards, and apparently in the future, if the federation discovers hidden areas or special areas and gives quotas to each country, the quotas will be chosen from the top ranks of the base...
I think it will be an interesting competition."

Lian did not say anything, but his mind was engaged, the first place of the Base, it was not a bad title, but it would make him more famous than before, although if the talk about quotas was true, he might have no choice.

After that, the discussion continued for a while, Kael tried to recruit him to be with them in the assault, even though the entire group did not like Lian, as the captain he believed having such a warrior with them was very good.
But Lian refused, if he became a member of a group, he would lose his freedom and tomorrow he would not be able to do what he wanted, so he preferred to advance alone.
Kael did not insist too much, and after saying goodbye, Lian returned to his room.
He took a shower, checked his equipment, and fell asleep without thinking about the treasure or the monsters.
The next morning.
The base had exploded, at least in terms of population, when he left the accommodation building, he saw thousands of people preparing.
Hunters, students, guild members, mercenary groups, and even independent awakened ones who had come just for this operation.
Lian had also registered his name in the operation list yesterday.
So he went to the gathering point, when he arrived there, for the first time he realized how many powerful awakened ones were present at the base.

Dozens above level twenty, several above level thirty, and right in the center of the crowd... a woman in black armor was standing, the aura she was emitting was more commanding and stronger than everyone around her.
The woman stepped forward a few steps and her voice was calm but powerful.
"Today is not a joke, this operation is dangerous, anyone who thinks they came for excitement, it is better to turn back right now."
The crowd fell silent, and she continued.
"We are entering the territory of a monster race, they will defend their home, and they will have no hesitation in killing you."
"So be careful, do not leave your group, and if things get bad, running away is better than dying."
A heavy silence fell, and then the woman raised her hand and gave the signal.
"We move."
A few seconds later, a massive wave of awakened ones left the base.
Hundreds of riding monsters, hundreds of people on foot, and dozens of powerful groups, all moving toward the Ironfang Ravagers’ lair.
Lian also mounted the Windrunner Strider and moved among this massive army.
No one knew what was waiting for them, no one knew what was hidden in the depths of that river.
And no one knew that today’s cleansing operation... was going to be their biggest mistake.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: The Army of Ironfang
paragraphs: A few hours after leaving the base, the surrounding scenery gradually changed.
The ordinary forests had given way to an area that screamed of the presence of a monster race.
The further the massive caravan of awakened ones went, the heavier the atmosphere became, along the path, scattered bones of monsters and various animals could be seen.
Some of them were so large that it was hard to imagine what could have killed them.
A few kilometers ahead, the remains of a completely destroyed caravan could be seen.
Broken wheels, bent metal, and remains of armors that once belonged to hunters, the trees in the area were not in better condition either, many of them had been split in half by massive claws.
Some others had been uprooted and fallen on the ground, and more importantly... the ground, the soil in many parts of the area was completely compacted.
As if thousands of heavy creatures had passed through it continuously.
Even the experienced awakened ones were no longer joking, the talking had decreased, faces had become more serious.
Everyone knew they had entered the true territory of the Ironfang Ravagers.
This was an area that, for weeks, from the very first days the base was established, awakened ones had tried to avoid and stay away from.

This was a large graveyard where hundreds of awakened ones had been massacred, this was no place for jokes, if they made a mistake for a moment and lowered their guard, it could cost them their lives.
At that same moment, the woman who was the commander of the operation gave the order to stop.
The crowd slowly stopped, she went toward the remains of a monster that was lying by the path, the rotten corpse of an Ironfang, even after death it had a terrifying appearance.
The woman said with a loud voice.
"Before we enter the main area, there is something you should know." She pointed at the monster’s skin with the tip of her sword.

"Poison, this creature is poisonous, some of you should know this, but I will repeat it to be safe, not just the teeth, not just the claws, the whole body, blood, flesh, skin, and even the steam that comes out of fresh wounds are poisonous."
A murmur formed among the crowd, a significant number were aware of this, some were not, but one thing was the same for everyone.
Their sense of danger increased and they realized they had to be careful not to touch these monsters directly under any circumstances.
Otherwise, today this place would become their graveyard as well.

"In the past few months, more than twenty novice hunters died just from touching the skin of these creatures, if you do not have an antidote, if you do not have protective equipment, and if you do not have poison resistance skills, it is better to keep your distance."
Upon hearing these words, Lian fell into thought, in fact, ever since he had obtained the Poison Bane skill, he had paid almost no attention to it.
But now...this skill could be much more valuable than he had imagined, but it only gave twenty percent resistance to poisons.
Although it was not small, it was not large either, and for such conditions it was very risky.
He immediately opened the system panel.
His number of fragments was still considerable, without hesitation he chose the upgrade option.
A faint blue light appeared in front of his eyes.
[ Poison Bane ]
[ Rank: Common → Great ]
[ Cost: 15 Fragments ]
[ Confirm? ]
Lian confirmed without pausing, and at that same moment a new notification appeared.
[ Poison Bane skill successfully upgraded ]
[ Skill Name: Poison Foe ]
[ Rank: Great ]
[ Description: Resistance to poison increases by up to 50%, when active it consumes 0.5 units of mana per minute. ]
Lian gave a small smile, fifty percent resistance to poison.
This number was now much better than before, and he no longer needed to worry too much, and unfortunately this was the maximum potential of this skill and it could not be upgraded further.
Now in practice, he was now one of the few people who could move among these monsters without serious worry.
After the commander’s explanations ended, the movement began again.
Lian moved forward among the crowd and soon found Kael’s group, the same five people, but this time their condition was completely different.
Rhea was wearing new red armor and carrying her massive sword on her shoulder.
Bren had placed his gigantic shield on the ground and was doing his final checks.
Zak was sharpening his sword blade with full concentration.
Elias was busy preparing potions and checking his medical equipment.
And Kael...as always calm, was examining the map of the area on a holographic screen.
It was clear that they were completely prepared for this operation, no sign of joking or carelessness could be seen on their faces.
They had come to hunt and they had taken this matter completely seriously.
It was not just them, everyone was serious for this mission, the better they could hunt, the more reward they would receive, the more they hunted, the more they could level up.
For many awakened ones, the complete destruction of this group of monsters was a great opportunity to finally gain a lot of experience without worry.
A few minutes later, the advance groups entered the forest, everyone expected to find a few scattered monsters.
"Be careful! The enemy is approaching!"
But the reality was very different, suddenly an Ironfang jumped out from among the trees.
Then a second one.
A third one.
A fourth one.
And then dozens of other monsters, multiple roars echoed in the forest, and within seconds the battlefield exploded.
Swords were drawn, spells were activated, and the monsters attacked from all directions.
And everyone understood why the government had decided to carry out such a large operation.
But Lian was in no hurry to enter, he observed the scene from a distance, he wanted to learn their behavior patterns, find their weak points, and identify the best way to kill them.
And what he saw was truly strange, these monsters did not attack blindly, some of them played the role of hunters.
They went directly toward the weaker targets, and others moved from the flanks and tried to surround the groups.
And a few stayed back, waiting for the best opportunity, like an army, like soldiers who had specific duties.
This matter was even more dangerous than their numbers, because it showed they were not just a bunch of mindless stupid monsters, but they knew how to fight.
Of course, considering that a few Fallen ones were leading them, it should not have been that surprising.
At that moment, one of the monsters broke away from the right flank, it had targeted a few young students.
The students had just noticed the danger, if that creature reached them...their death was almost certain.
Lian did not wait any longer, explosive power flowed through his muscles, the ground beneath his feet cracked, and his body shot forward like a bullet.
The monster was still a few meters away from the students, but Lian arrived sooner, lightning gathered on his right fist.
[ Thunder Calamity ]
Blue sparks danced in the air, and then...his fist landed.
An explosion.
The Ironfang’s skull was literally shattered, the monster’s body was thrown several meters into the air and fell to the ground with great force.
The entire scene fell silent for a moment.
The system notification appeared.
[ Ironfang Ravager level 21 killed ]
[ EXP Gained ]
[ Stats Gained: +11 ]
[ You have obtained a new skill! ]
Lian’s eyes widened slightly, eleven stats, just from one monster, this amount was even more than what he had expected.
And more importantly...this was only one of hundreds of monsters, of course, he had received this amount because he had killed the monster alone.
If it had been a group kill, he would have gotten fewer points.
’I should try to hunt the ones with lower levels by myself.’ He thought to himself, he could not miss such a good opportunity to become stronger.
"Thank you so much." The rescued students thanked him sincerely, and Lian nodded and did not stay there any longer.
At that same moment, Kael, who had seen the scene from a distance, fixed his gaze on Lian, he was the first one to notice that Lian had not even gotten serious yet.
That speed...that power...and that calmness, none of them were like a normal awakened one.
"Who is this boy really?"
"I have seen him at the academy center a few times, could he be a student?"
"Impossible..."
A few others also had their attention drawn, and the more they looked at Lian, the more their curiosity grew, even the commander of the operation gave a quick glance at him.
To be able to kill a level 21 monster with one hit, one must be at least level 25, but she knew all the level 25 awakened ones at the base.
So who was this? But she had no time to think.
Because suddenly, one of the commanders shouted with a loud voice.
"They are coming from the river side!"
Everyone turned their heads, in the distance, a massive cloud of dust was approaching.
And then hundreds of Ironfang Ravagers appeared from among the trees, their numbers were so many that even some hunters lost their color.
But this was still not the worst part, among them...a few larger creatures were moving.
Black armor, larger bodies, larger horns...Fallen Ironfang Ravagers.
The system notification appeared in front of everyone’s eyes.
[ Ironfang Ravagers Detected ]
[ Rank: Fallen ]
[ Level: 27 ]
And at that same moment, everyone understood... the battle had begun.

chapters.title: Chapter 143: Hunting in the Chaos
paragraphs: What initially seemed like a simple cleansing operation quickly turned into something completely different.
The forest had exploded, the sound of screams, explosions, roars, and the clash of weapons could be heard from every direction.
Trees were falling one after another, the ground was shaking under the continuous waves of mana.
Every time one of the groups thought they had cleared an area, dozens more Ironfang Ravagers would jump out from among the bushes, underground tunnels, or behind the trees.
As if the entire forest had come alive, the commanders soon realized that the initial information had been wrong.
The number of monsters was much higher than what they had expected.
For this reason, several temporary defensive lines were formed, the lower-level awakened ones were placed in the back.
The stronger ones stayed at the front line, but even they were under pressure, on the eastern side of the field, a five-person group had managed to kill nearly twenty Ironfang Ravagers.
The group members breathed a sigh of relief, only for the sound of breaking branches to be heard from deep within the forest a moment later.
Then more than thirty new Ironfang Ravagers jumped out from the shadows, everyone’s faces changed.
The battle had only just begun.
No one could have even a moment of peace or rest for a while, this was a battle for the complete extermination of a race, and such operations could always lead to unknown variables.
Everyone knew it would not be easy, but they did not expect it to be this hard, until now they had also suffered dozens of casualties.
Even two of the strongest awakened ones had been killed by the Fallen ones, everyone thought the mission would be easy because of the large number of awakened ones.
But they were badly mistaken.
In all this chaos, Lian was not fighting like the others, he was hunting, there was a big difference between the two.
Most people were fighting to survive or protect others.
But Lian was fighting to grow, for stats and for exp, which result in becoming stronger.
In one part of the field, three Ironfang Ravagers attacked two young students.
One of the students raised his shield, but the monster’s strike threw him back several meters.
The second student was ready to die, but suddenly the sound of thunder echoed in the air, Lian’s body moved through the trees like a ghost.
Lightning had gathered on his right fist.
[ Thunder Calamity ]
His fist hit the Ironfang’s skull directly, the sound of bones shattering echoed in the air, the monster’s body flew several meters and hit a tree.
The tree broke in half, the system notification appeared.
[ Ironfang Ravager level 19 Eliminated ]
[ EXP Gained ]
[ Stats +10 ]
Lian did not even stop, before the other two monsters noticed his presence, he increased his speed.
The ground beneath his feet cracked, he turned, a massive ice claw formed on his left hand.
[ Glacial Reaper Claw ]
A horizontal strike, the second monster’s chest was torn open, and poisonous blood splattered on the ground.
But Poison Foe was active and his body showed no reaction, the third monster roared and jumped at him.
Lian just stepped aside, the monster’s teeth passed a few centimeters from his face, and then he drove his elbow into the creature’s side.
[ Thunder Calamity ] was activated again.
The thunder exploded inside the monster’s body, and the Ironfang fell to the ground.
Three hunts, in less than ten seconds, then Lian disappeared, all the monsters he went after were intentionally below level 22.
The reason was simple, he could hunt monsters below level 22 with a few punches and at high speed, but the higher-level ones were harder and more time-consuming, and it was not worth it.
In another part of the field, Kael’s group was showing why they were famous.
Three Ironfang Ravagers attacked Bren at the same time, the creatures roared and jumped on him, but Bren did not step back even one step.
[ Fortress Heart ]
Mana veins shone on his armor, his muscles swelled, he raised his massive shield in front of him, the strikes of three monsters landed at the same time.
The ground beneath his feet cracked, but he remained like a wall.
At that same moment, Rhea passed by him, flames twisted around her large sword.
[ Blazing Charge ]

She entered the field like a fiery meteor, she cut the first Ironfang in half, the monster’s body split into two pieces, and before the blood could fall to the ground, Rhea turned toward the second target.
A vertical strike from her sword crushed the creature’s shoulder.
At the same moment, Zak disappeared.
[ Hidden Step ]
No one saw his movement path, he appeared behind the third Ironfang.
[ Shadow Sever ]
His sword passed through the monster’s neck like a dark shadow, the creature’s head fell to the ground.
Elias was standing in the back of the field, his hands shining with golden light, and every few seconds a wound on the group members’ bodies would disappear.
Sometimes he also activated Life Transfer and transferred part of his own mana to Rhea or Bren.
But the most dangerous member was still Kael, the lightning mage calmly raised his hand, a few Ironfang Ravagers were running toward the group.
A massive magic circle appeared in the air.
[ Thunder Spear ]
A spear of lightning fell from the sky, the resulting explosion from the impact destroyed four monsters at the same time, the blue light of the thunder illuminated the entire forest for a moment.
Among the groups formed for this operation, they were one of the most successful, and all of them were not far from reaching level 20, and their main goal was to reach that level today.
But other parts of the field had a different situation, where the Fallen monsters had appeared.
For the first time, real fear could be seen among the awakened ones, a level twenty-two hunter moved forward confidently.
He probably thought that no matter how powerful the Fallen ones were, he could at least land a few hits and successfully retreat.
He raised his sword, shouted, and attacked.
Three seconds later, the upper half of his body was on the ground, the Fallen monster had not even stopped.
A heavy silence fell over the area.
A few people lost their color, many understood that this operation could easily turn into a graveyard.
An awakened one who had passed their first evolution had been killed that easily.
In the heart of the battlefield, the level twenty-seven Fallen monster was present.
A massive giant, larger than all the members of its race.
The commanders were personally engaged with it, massive explosions were happening one after another.
Fire.
Lightning.
Mana blades.
Each attack could destroy a normal monster, but the Fallen Ironfang just stepped back a few steps, that was all.
When one of the spells hit its chest directly, the creature roared and charged forward again.
Several level thirty hunters were forced to stop it at the same time.
Lian watched from a distance and immediately concluded, if he entered a battle with that monster alone, his chance of survival was low.
Maybe he could deal damage, maybe even land a few good hits, but in the end he would be killed, the power gap between him and a level 27 Fallen was too large.
If his guess was correct, that monster had the power of a normal level 40 monster or higher, and now there were several of them here.
Defeating them was not going to be easy, but fortunately, the commanders of this operation were not empty-handed either and had some trump cards.
He decided to act logically, that battle was not his, at least not for now, he had hunted as much as he wanted, and his number of stats had reached 211.
There were no monsters below level 22 left here anymore, so the time had come to go after his main goal.
While observing the field from the branch of a tall tree, he noticed something.
Almost all the main forces were moving toward the center of the nest, even the Fallen monsters were slowly retreating.
They were drawing the awakened ones toward the heart of their territory, and this matter had one important result.
The path to the river was almost empty.

Lian stood on the branch and looked around, thousands of people were engaged in battle, all attention was focused on the monsters, the commanders were leading the forces, and the hunters were fighting to survive.
No one was looking at the river... no one.
All these conditions were screaming only one thing, and it was completely clear, finally the time had come.
A smile appeared on his face.
"Now is a good opportunity." And without anyone noticing, he quietly jumped down from the branch and headed toward the river.

The thunder exploded inside the monster’s body, and the Ironfang fell to the ground.
Three hunts, in less than ten seconds, then Lian disappeared, all the monsters he went after were intentionally below level 22.
The reason was simple, he could hunt monsters below level 22 with a few punches and at high speed, but the higher-level ones were harder and more time-consuming, and it was not worth it.
In another part of the field, Kael’s group was showing why they were famous.
Three Ironfang Ravagers attacked Bren at the same time, the creatures roared and jumped on him, but Bren did not step back even one step.
[ Fortress Heart ]
Mana veins shone on his armor, his muscles swelled, he raised his massive shield in front of him, the strikes of three monsters landed at the same time.
The ground beneath his feet cracked, but he remained like a wall.
At that same moment, Rhea passed by him, flames twisted around her large sword.
[ Blazing Charge ]

She entered the field like a fiery meteor, she cut the first Ironfang in half, the monster’s body split into two pieces, and before the blood could fall to the ground, Rhea turned toward the second target.
A vertical strike from her sword crushed the creature’s shoulder.
At the same moment, Zak disappeared.
[ Hidden Step ]
No one saw his movement path, he appeared behind the third Ironfang.
[ Shadow Sever ]
His sword passed through the monster’s neck like a dark shadow, the creature’s head fell to the ground.
Elias was standing in the back of the field, his hands shining with golden light, and every few seconds a wound on the group members’ bodies would disappear.
Sometimes he also activated Life Transfer and transferred part of his own mana to Rhea or Bren.
But the most dangerous member was still Kael, the lightning mage calmly raised his hand, a few Ironfang Ravagers were running toward the group.
A massive magic circle appeared in the air.
[ Thunder Spear ]
A spear of lightning fell from the sky, the resulting explosion from the impact destroyed four monsters at the same time, the blue light of the thunder illuminated the entire forest for a moment.
Among the groups formed for this operation, they were one of the most successful, and all of them were not far from reaching level 20, and their main goal was to reach that level today.
But other parts of the field had a different situation, where the Fallen monsters had appeared.
For the first time, real fear could be seen among the awakened ones, a level twenty-two hunter moved forward confidently.
He probably thought that no matter how powerful the Fallen ones were, he could at least land a few hits and successfully retreat.
He raised his sword, shouted, and attacked.
Three seconds later, the upper half of his body was on the ground, the Fallen monster had not even stopped.
A heavy silence fell over the area.
A few people lost their color, many understood that this operation could easily turn into a graveyard.
An awakened one who had passed their first evolution had been killed that easily.
In the heart of the battlefield, the level twenty-seven Fallen monster was present.
A massive giant, larger than all the members of its race.
The commanders were personally engaged with it, massive explosions were happening one after another.
Fire.
Lightning.
Mana blades.
Each attack could destroy a normal monster, but the Fallen Ironfang just stepped back a few steps, that was all.
When one of the spells hit its chest directly, the creature roared and charged forward again.
Several level thirty hunters were forced to stop it at the same time.
Lian watched from a distance and immediately concluded, if he entered a battle with that monster alone, his chance of survival was low.
Maybe he could deal damage, maybe even land a few good hits, but in the end he would be killed, the power gap between him and a level 27 Fallen was too large.
If his guess was correct, that monster had the power of a normal level 40 monster or higher, and now there were several of them here.
Defeating them was not going to be easy, but fortunately, the commanders of this operation were not empty-handed either and had some trump cards.
He decided to act logically, that battle was not his, at least not for now, he had hunted as much as he wanted, and his number of stats had reached 211.
There were no monsters below level 22 left here anymore, so the time had come to go after his main goal.
While observing the field from the branch of a tall tree, he noticed something.
Almost all the main forces were moving toward the center of the nest, even the Fallen monsters were slowly retreating.
They were drawing the awakened ones toward the heart of their territory, and this matter had one important result.
The path to the river was almost empty.

Lian stood on the branch and looked around, thousands of people were engaged in battle, all attention was focused on the monsters, the commanders were leading the forces, and the hunters were fighting to survive.
No one was looking at the river... no one.
All these conditions were screaming only one thing, and it was completely clear, finally the time had come.
A smile appeared on his face.
"Now is a good opportunity." And without anyone noticing, he quietly jumped down from the branch and headed toward the river.

chapters.title: Chapter 144: Touch the Unknown
paragraphs: Lian jumped down from the tree and took one last look at the battlefield.
In the distance, the battle was still continuing with insane intensity, blue thunder was splitting the sky, fiery explosions were rising from the forest.

The roars of the Fallen ones were shaking the ground, thousands of people were engaged in a battle that was taking victims every moment, and in such chaos, the disappearance of one person would not even be noticed.
Besides, unlike the outside world where he was completely known in the country, many of these people had been in this Ruined Realm for a considerable time and did not recognize him.
This meant that his disappearance would not attract attention for a while.
He took out the book of treasure to pinpoint the location of the treasure, and the book would not stay calm, it was trembling more intensely every moment.
As if something in the depths of the river was calling him, something that had been waiting for him for a long time.
Lian did not waste any time, he crossed the path and reached the riverbank, the river water looked like a living liquid.
He took a deep breath, then threw himself into the water, at that same moment he realized something was wrong.
"Damn it, what is going on here?" Very wrong... his body suddenly became heavy.
The water around him was not like normal water, every movement required more effort, as if he was moving inside liquid metal instead of swimming in water.
The river’s current was also wilder than what could be seen from the surface, hidden forces in the depths were pulling his body in different directions.

Even with his current power, he had to inject mana into his muscles to maintain his balance, and it was very dark here, and it was hard to see anything, as if light from outside could not penetrate into this place.
But it was not a problem for him, and his eyes shone in the darkness, Night Eyes was activated.
The dark world around him suddenly became bright, he could see the real riverbed, massive rocks, deep pits, and cracks that were left open like the mouths of monsters in the darkness.
Was this really a river? This looked more like an ocean than a river.
He had heard that everything inside the Ruined Realm could be bigger and more terrifying, but seeing such a thing was still amazing.
And the creatures moving among them, one of them suddenly jumped out from beside a rock.
It had a slender and semi-transparent body, nearly two meters long, and its mouth was full of metal and needle-like teeth.
The system notification appeared.
[ River Fang Eel ]
[ Rank: Normal ]
[ Level: 20 ]
The eel attacked directly toward Lian’s throat, but Lian was faster, a massive ice claw formed on his arm.
[ Glacial Reaper Claw ]
The water around him froze, the ice claw passed through the eel’s body, and the creature’s blue blood spread in the water.
The eel’s body was split in half.
[ You killed a level 20 River Fang Eel ]
[ You gained EXP ]
[ You gained 9 stats ]
[ You obtained a skill ]
But this was not the end, three other shadows came out from the cracks.
Then two more, within a few seconds six River Fang Eels surrounded him.
Lian frowned a little upon seeing them, he did not expect another race to live inside this river, and according to the book of treasure, these monsters lived near that unknown treasure.
And this made him even more interested in that treasure than before, something that could attract so many monsters... God knew what it could be.
Using Thunder Calamity here was dangerous, the lightning would spread in the water and might trap him too.
So he had to fight in a different way, the first eel attacked from the left.
He turned his body, the ice claw severed its neck.
The second attacked from behind, Lian hit its head with his elbow and the monster’s skull bones shattered.
The third managed to bite his arm, but its bite could not pass through his armor, let alone reach Diamond Skin.
Lian punched its head and the creature’s skull exploded.
System notifications appeared one after another.
But his attention was elsewhere, the distance to the target was getting shorter every moment.
187 meters.
162 meters.
141 meters.
The deeper he went, the stranger the river became, the color of the water had changed, it was no longer colorless and blue, dark red veins could be seen in it.
The rocks were covered with black crystals, crystals that sometimes pulsed like hearts.
And worse of all... the sound.
Beats that were heard directly in his mind, not in his ears, but in the depths of his mind.
Boom...
Boom...
Boom...
The book of treasure was almost going crazy, the red point was constantly flashing.
Distance:
120 meters.
98 meters.
73 meters.
51 meters.
Then suddenly his body stopped, something had moved in the darkness, at first he thought it was a rock wall, but the rock wall moved.
Massive eyes opened in the darkness, Lian felt the blood in his veins freeze, and every cell in his body was screaming one after another: Danger! Run!
The system notification appeared.
[ Abyssal River Drake ]
[ Rank: Fallen ]
[ Level: 35 ]
The gigantic creature was swimming calmly in the water, its body was larger than many of the base’s buildings, and its dark scales were covered with red veins.
Its golden eyes pierced the darkness, but there was something strange, the monster did not attack Lian.
Instead, it was swimming in a specific circle, as if protecting something.
At that same moment, Lian understood, this creature was a guardian, and what it was protecting... was the treasure itself.
He breathed with difficulty, now he understood why the book had identified the threat level as high, if he entered a battle directly, he would not survive even a few seconds.
And the fact that the monster was not attacking him right now was itself a stroke of luck, if it attacked him, he would really be in great danger.
Not that he would be in danger of death, because he could still use the exit ability and save himself.
But fortunately, he did not always fight with raw power alone, sometimes intelligence was more valuable, his eyes fixed on his number of fragments.
He made his decision.
[ Shadow Skin ]
A skill that could be useful here, but not with this rank, it was time to upgrade.
The system notification appeared.
[ Shadow Skin ]
[ Upgrade Available ]
[ Cost: 15 Fragments ]
Lian confirmed without hesitation, the fragments disappeared.
[ Shadow Skin has advanced to Great Rank ]
But he did not stop, and the notification appeared again.
[ Upgrade Available ]
[ Cost: 65 Fragments ]
This time he paused, sixty-five fragments, it was not a small number, but what was in front of him was also not normal, for his safety and to obtain that treasure, it was necessary.
He confirmed.
Suddenly a massive wave of mana covered his entire body.
The shadows around him were drawn toward him, the river water became darker for a moment.
Then a new notification appeared.
[ Shadow Skin has evolved ]
[ New Skill Acquired ]
[ Abyss Veil ]
[ Rank: Divine ]

[ Description: The user is covered in a veil of absolute shadows and merges with them, and can move freely within them. As long as he does not attack or directly collide with a target, his presence, mana, sound, and physical trace are hidden from the perception of surrounding creatures. Consumes 7 units of mana per minute. ]
Lian’s eyes sparkled, the ability to hide had reached a level beyond normal skills, and this level of hiding was unmatched.
Although 7 mana per minute was very high, he had to do his work quickly, or his mana would run out.
He activated the skill, the shadows swallowed his body, and within a few seconds his presence disappeared, even he himself felt like part of the darkness.
Then he calmly moved toward the center of the guardian’s range.
The Abyssal River Drake passed by him several times from a few meters away.
Each time Lian’s heart beat faster, if the monster noticed... everything would be over, but it did not, and the guardian continued swimming on its path.
Lian moved forward calmly.
Ten meters.
Eight meters.
Five meters.
Then finally he saw it, but he was surprised by what he saw, there was no chest, no weapon, and no legendary plant.
In the middle of the riverbed... a massive egg was lying.
It was more than three meters tall, red and black veins covered its entire surface.
Every few seconds, a dark light passed through it, as if something inside it was alive.
The book’s notification appeared.
[ Unknown ]
[ Condition: Dormant ]
[ Physical Contact Required ]
Lian moved forward calmly, his eyes fixed on the guardian for a moment, the monster still had not noticed him, then his gaze fell on the strange egg again.
Could it be the egg of that monster? But his intuition told him that was not the case.
He just had to touch it, just one touch... he reached his hand forward.
His fingers slowly approached the egg’s surface, and the moment his skin touched its surface... the system notifications appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 145: The End Of Operation
paragraphs: Lian remained floating in silence in the red darkness of the river depths, keeping his fingers on the egg’s surface.
Its surface was warm, not like stone, not like metal, but like the skin of a living creature.
Right at that moment, the book of treasure exploded, not literally, but all its golden pages began to tremble with an intensity that Lian had never seen before.
The golden lines on the pages lit up, information appeared and then disappeared, appeared again.
As if even the book itself was having trouble identifying what was in front of it.
Lian had never seen such a thing before, he did not know if this was normal or a very rare event, he did not have much information about this book himself.
But if he was going to bet, he would bet that it was an extremely rare event that perhaps even the Vorhelms had never seen the book behave this way.
A few seconds later, the information lines finally stabilized.
[ Unknown Lifeform Detected ]
[ Classification Failed ]
[ Name Identified ]
[ The Devourer of Devourers ]
[ Status: Dormant ]
[ Growth Stage: Embryonic ]
[ Threat Assessment: Impossible ]
Lian’s eyes narrowed.
"Devourer...?"
"Devourer of Devourers?"
The information had no other explanation.
No rank, no value, no threat level, and not even a description of what this creature exactly was.
Only a name.
The Devourer of Devourers.
A name that sounded more like a legend than a living creature.

Lian stayed there for a few moments, trying to review all the information he had in his mind about all the Ruined Realms, legendary creatures and ... to see if he could find any information about such a thing or not, and the result was already clear, this egg was still unknown.
"What should I do with it?" What could he do with an unknown egg? An egg that even the Celestial Book of Treasure could not determine its value?
If it was someone else, they would probably leave the egg behind.
But he was not that kind of person, if the book of treasure had reacted this much to find something, its value was unimaginable.
But his intuition warned him that this egg was very dangerous, more dangerous than anything he could think of.
His gaze went toward the massive shadow in the distance, the Abyssal River Drake, the Fallen monster was still patrolling around the area.
Fortunately, it was far away, but it was unknown how long this situation would last.
So he made his decision, without the slightest hesitation he touched the egg, the next moment the egg disappeared and went into his storage space.
And at that same moment... the entire river trembled, a weak tremor, but real, as if it had lost its heart.
Lian’s eyes opened wide, his heart stopped for a moment, his gaze immediately went toward the Fallen monster.
The massive creature raised its head for a moment, its several dozen meter long body moved through the red water current and moved even further away.
Lian even stopped breathing, but fortunately the monster continued on its path again.
It had not noticed anything, or at least it had not noticed yet.
"I have to go." He did not stay there for even one more second.
Abyss Veil was still active and his body moved through the heavy water current.
On the way back, a few River Fang Eels came out from beside the rocks.
Massive eels with metal teeth, but this time Lian did not even look at them, he had no time to fight and no reason to.
His only goal was to get out of the river, as fast as possible, as far away as possible, he did not know how that monster would react when it realized the egg was no longer there.
But he was sure it was not going to be a good reaction.
A few minutes later, he finally emerged from the water surface, the open air rushed into his lungs, he sat on the ground and breathed a sigh of relief.
Water droplets were dripping from his hair, his gaze went toward the river again.
There was no sign of pursuit, no sign that the theft had been noticed yet.
"Good... very good." Lian let out a quiet sigh, the theft operation had been successful, but it was unclear how long it would last.
Then he got up, it was time to return.
The closer he got to the battlefield, the louder the sounds of war became.
Roars, explosions, screams.
When he finally reached the main area, even he himself stopped for a moment.
The battlefield no longer looked like a forest, it looked like hell, hundreds of Ironfang corpses lay on the ground.
Blood covered the entire area, massive trees were broken, the ground had collapsed dozens of meters due to spells and explosions.
But the operation had almost succeeded.
Almost.
Only two Fallen monsters remained.
[ Fallen Ironfang Alpha ]
[ Level 28 ]
[ Fallen Ironfang Tyrant ]
[ Level 29 ]
Both were drenched in blood but still fighting, and both had become more dangerous than ever because both had entered the berserk state.
Their metal skin was covered with a layer of blood, the [ Blood Sucking Skin ] skill was active.
Every drop of blood that settled on their bodies was absorbed into their natural armor, and the more blood they absorbed, the stronger they became.
Swords sparked on their bodies and spells barely penetrated their flesh.
Then one of them took a deep wound, and right at that moment Blood Frenzy was activated.
The monster’s eyes became redder, its muscles swelled, and its speed almost doubled, a level twenty-six hunter had no chance to react.
The monster’s claw passed by his body and the man was thrown back right there.
Everyone understood that these two monsters, on the verge of death, were much more dangerous than at the start of the battle, suddenly the Fallen Ironfang Tyrant raised its head.
Then it activated Ravager Roar, a massive roar shook the entire field.
The air trembled, a few low-level students knelt right there, the mana of some people was completely disrupted for a few seconds.
Even a few people ran back in panic, but the high-level hunters remained standing and the battle continued.
In the center of the field, the female commander was engaged with the Tyrant.
Her massive sword crushed the monster’s armor with every strike, but the monster kept fighting.
At that same moment, Lian entered the field, not to save anyone, not to play the hero.
But for EXP, he entered from the flank and his body moved like a shadow through the chaos, it is true that he could not defeat them alone.
But if there was a powerful group, he could still help them defeat these two monsters.
[ Thunder Calamity ] gathered on his arm.
Thunder twisted around his fist, then he threw his punch.
An explosion.
The monster was pushed back several full meters.
Everyone was shocked for a moment, Rhea who was fighting from a distance looked with disbelief.
"This crazy guy again..."
But she had no time to think more, because immediately she attacked again.
Blazing Charge was activated.
Her flaming sword sank into the Fallen Alpha’s body, from the other side Zak appeared.
Shadow Sever.
His blade passed through the armor crack, Kael was also not idle, dozens of thunder spears fell from the sky one after another.
The entire field lit up, all the remaining awakened ones regardless of their level were helping to defeat these two remaining Fallen ones.
Bren stood with his shield against direct attacks, and Elias was treating the wounded without stopping in the back of the field.
Everyone fought together, everyone attacked together, and finally the result appeared.
The Fallen Ironfang Alpha was the first to fall.
Its massive body fell to the ground after the final strike.
The ground trembled but the battle was not over yet, everyone focused their attention on the Tyrant, the level twenty-nine monster was still resisting.
But the number of its enemies was too many, out of the thousands of awakened ones who had come, many of them were still alive and were attacking this Fallen one simultaneously.
It did not matter how powerful it was, standing against this many humans was practically impossible for it.
One strike.
Two strikes.
Dozens of spells.
Hundreds of attacks.
In the end, even it could not hold on, its massive body trembled and its red eyes went dark, and with a heavy sound it fell to the ground.
Silence.
After hours of fighting, silence covered the field... the cleansing operation had succeeded.
But at that very moment... inside Lian’s storage space... something else happened.
The egg... the Devourer’s egg, began to pulse.
Once, just once, but that one pulse was enough.
Lian felt it, as if something inside the egg had awakened and was hungry, very hungry.
He felt something inside that egg... wanted to devour all the living and dead creatures that were here.

Lian stayed there for a few moments, trying to review all the information he had in his mind about all the Ruined Realms, legendary creatures and ... to see if he could find any information about such a thing or not, and the result was already clear, this egg was still unknown.
"What should I do with it?" What could he do with an unknown egg?
An egg that even the Celestial Book of Treasure could not determine its value?
If it was someone else, they would probably leave the egg behind.
But he was not that kind of person, if the book of treasure had reacted this much to find something, its value was unimaginable.
But his intuition warned him that this egg was very dangerous, more dangerous than anything he could think of.
His gaze went toward the massive shadow in the distance, the Abyssal River Drake, the Fallen monster was still patrolling around the area.
Fortunately, it was far away, but it was unknown how long this situation would last.
So he made his decision, without the slightest hesitation he touched the egg, the next moment the egg disappeared and went into his storage space.
And at that same moment... the entire river trembled, a weak tremor, but real, as if it had lost its heart.
Lian’s eyes opened wide, his heart stopped for a moment, his gaze immediately went toward the Fallen monster.
The massive creature raised its head for a moment, its several dozen meter long body moved through the red water current and moved even further away.
Lian even stopped breathing, but fortunately the monster continued on its path again.
It had not noticed anything, or at least it had not noticed yet.
"I have to go." He did not stay there for even one more second.
Abyss Veil was still active and his body moved through the heavy water current.
On the way back, a few River Fang Eels came out from beside the rocks.
Massive eels with metal teeth, but this time Lian did not even look at them, he had no time to fight and no reason to.
His only goal was to get out of the river, as fast as possible, as far away as possible, he did not know how that monster would react when it realized the egg was no longer there.
But he was sure it was not going to be a good reaction.
A few minutes later, he finally emerged from the water surface, the open air rushed into his lungs, he sat on the ground and breathed a sigh of relief.
Water droplets were dripping from his hair, his gaze went toward the river again.
There was no sign of pursuit, no sign that the theft had been noticed yet.
"Good... very good." Lian let out a quiet sigh, the theft operation had been successful, but it was unclear how long it would last.
Then he got up, it was time to return.
The closer he got to the battlefield, the louder the sounds of war became.
Roars, explosions, screams.
When he finally reached the main area, even he himself stopped for a moment.
The battlefield no longer looked like a forest, it looked like hell, hundreds of Ironfang corpses lay on the ground.
Blood covered the entire area, massive trees were broken, the ground had collapsed dozens of meters due to spells and explosions.
But the operation had almost succeeded.
Almost.
Only two Fallen monsters remained.
[ Fallen Ironfang Alpha ]
[ Level 28 ]
[ Fallen Ironfang Tyrant ]
[ Level 29 ]
Both were drenched in blood but still fighting, and both had become more dangerous than ever because both had entered the berserk state.
Their metal skin was covered with a layer of blood, the [ Blood Sucking Skin ] skill was active.
Every drop of blood that settled on their bodies was absorbed into their natural armor, and the more blood they absorbed, the stronger they became.
Swords sparked on their bodies and spells barely penetrated their flesh.
Then one of them took a deep wound, and right at that moment Blood Frenzy was activated.
The monster’s eyes became redder, its muscles swelled, and its speed almost doubled, a level twenty-six hunter had no chance to react.
The monster’s claw passed by his body and the man was thrown back right there.
Everyone understood that these two monsters, on the verge of death, were much more dangerous than at the start of the battle, suddenly the Fallen Ironfang Tyrant raised its head.
Then it activated Ravager Roar, a massive roar shook the entire field.
The air trembled, a few low-level students knelt right there, the mana of some people was completely disrupted for a few seconds.
Even a few people ran back in panic, but the high-level hunters remained standing and the battle continued.
In the center of the field, the female commander was engaged with the Tyrant.
Her massive sword crushed the monster’s armor with every strike, but the monster kept fighting.
At that same moment, Lian entered the field, not to save anyone, not to play the hero.
But for EXP, he entered from the flank and his body moved like a shadow through the chaos, it is true that he could not defeat them alone.
But if there was a powerful group, he could still help them defeat these two monsters.
[ Thunder Calamity ] gathered on his arm.
Thunder twisted around his fist, then he threw his punch.
An explosion.
The monster was pushed back several full meters.
Everyone was shocked for a moment, Rhea who was fighting from a distance looked with disbelief.
"This crazy guy again..."
But she had no time to think more, because immediately she attacked again.
Blazing Charge was activated.
Her flaming sword sank into the Fallen Alpha’s body, from the other side Zak appeared.
Shadow Sever.
His blade passed through the armor crack, Kael was also not idle, dozens of thunder spears fell from the sky one after another.
The entire field lit up, all the remaining awakened ones regardless of their level were helping to defeat these two remaining Fallen ones.
Bren stood with his shield against direct attacks, and Elias was treating the wounded without stopping in the back of the field.
Everyone fought together, everyone attacked together, and finally the result appeared.
The Fallen Ironfang Alpha was the first to fall.
Its massive body fell to the ground after the final strike.
The ground trembled but the battle was not over yet, everyone focused their attention on the Tyrant, the level twenty-nine monster was still resisting.
But the number of its enemies was too many, out of the thousands of awakened ones who had come, many of them were still alive and were attacking this Fallen one simultaneously.
It did not matter how powerful it was, standing against this many humans was practically impossible for it.
One strike.
Two strikes.
Dozens of spells.
Hundreds of attacks.
In the end, even it could not hold on, its massive body trembled and its red eyes went dark, and with a heavy sound it fell to the ground.
Silence.
After hours of fighting, silence covered the field... the cleansing operation had succeeded.
But at that very moment... inside Lian’s storage space... something else happened.
The egg... the Devourer’s egg, began to pulse.
Once, just once, but that one pulse was enough.
Lian felt it, as if something inside the egg had awakened and was hungry, very hungry.
He felt something inside that egg... wanted to devour all the living and dead creatures that were here.

chapters.title: Chapter 146: A Big Appetite
paragraphs: The death of the last Fallen Ironfang marked the official end of the battle.
But the battlefield had not calmed down yet, where a few hours earlier it looked like a green forest, now it had turned into a ruined land.
The trees were broken, the soil had been turned over by continuous explosions, massive craters could be seen in various places.
The smell of blood, smoke, burnt flesh, and mana was in the air.
Hundreds of Ironfang Ravager corpses lay on the ground, some of them had turned into piles of crushed flesh.
Some others remained exactly in the state they were killed in.
Hunters and awakened ones were scattered all over the area, busy collecting loot.
Teeth were being separated, horns were being cut off, the hearts of the monsters were being placed in special boxes.
The skins were being carefully removed from the bodies, almost no part of a monster was worthless, every part could become a weapon, armor, medicine, or magical material.
Of course, maximum caution had to be taken, otherwise their poisonous skin and blood could cause harm.
Shortly after, caravans carrying loot arrived from the base, massive pack monsters whose height was taller than some buildings entered the field.
Steel chains were tied to the corpses, armored carts were filled one after another, within a few minutes the entire area looked like a massive mine being extracted.

Lian was standing on one of the rocks watching everything, after much difficulty and effort he had managed to calm that egg which seemed to want to devour all the creatures here, now he had a chance to look at this scene.
Even without a precise calculation, he could guess that the financial value of this operation would be staggering.
Just the corpses of the Ironfang Ravagers were worth millions of dollars, and that was before counting the Fallen ones.
A few minutes later, the commander’s voice spread across the entire field.
Everyone slowly gathered, and the female commander stood on a large rock.
Her face was still tired, her armor was damaged in several places, one of the biggest burdens of responsibility for this battle was on her shoulders.
Fighting for several hours against Fallen monsters that had passed their first evolution was not easy, if it were not for everyone’s help in killing them, they might not have even been able to win.
When silence fell, she spoke.
"The cleansing operation was completed successfully."
The sound of cheering and shouting spread through the crowd, this was very good news for everyone, this was the first step in securing the base area up to a 400 kilometer radius.
The commander let them release their excitement for a few seconds and then continued.
"The thirty million dollar reward has been confirmed and it has been decided to double it for your efforts."
This time the crowd’s sound became even louder, smiles appeared on many faces, and some raised their fists in excitement.
The commander raised her hand and silence fell again.
"The main reward will be divided based on Contribution, also for each monster killed, a separate reward has been considered."
"Group kills have a smaller share, solo kills have a full share."
A few people immediately started discussing and calculating, some were happy and some were dissatisfied.
But no one could deny that this operation was the most profitable mission of the past few months, each of them had easily earned tens of thousands of dollars today.
Those who had done more hunting and helped much more could have even made hundreds of thousands of dollars in profit.
Lian, however, did not pay much attention to the financial discussions, after the ceremony ended, he mounted the Windrunner Strider and returned to the base.
When he finally reached his room, for the first time he had the chance to check the system.
The moment he opened the status panel, several notifications appeared one after another.
[Level Up]
[Level 14 Reached]
His eyes fixed on the experience bar, the bar was almost halfway full, he had gone from level thirteen to fourteen in just one operation and had also covered half the path of the next level.
[ Stats Points : 290 ]
He had obtained 290 stats points!
He had managed to get a total of 240 points from killing all the monsters below level 22 and those few monsters in the river.

The other 50 points were for helping to kill the two Fallen ones, he had gotten 25 stats for each, considering that due to the group kill, he had only gotten half of one percent, this number was insane.
If he had killed those two monsters alone by himself, he would have gotten 50 stats points for each.

He also noticed a point, it did not matter how many members were in the group and how many people took part in killing the monster, if it was a group kill, he would get half of one percent of the monster’s stats.
If he killed the monster alone, he would get one percent of its stats as stats points, this gave him a fuller view of his innate skill.
Overall, the result was better than what he had expected, a brief smile appeared on his face.
But very soon that smile faded, because something more important than leveling up was waiting for him.
The egg.
He reached his hand toward the storage space and the next moment the massive egg appeared on the room floor, red and black lights were flowing on its surface.
The shining veins on the shell were moving calmly, and more importantly... it was still pulsing.
Calmly, regularly, like the heart of a creature that had not yet been born.
Lian stared at it for a few minutes, the more he looked, the more he felt that something about this egg was not normal.
He took out the book of treasure to see if any change had occurred in the description of this monster... and there was no change.
Finally, a thought came to his mind, on the battlefield, when the surroundings were full of monster corpses.
The egg had reacted, so maybe... there was a connection.
He took out one of the monster corpses he had obtained yesterday from the storage space.
The heavy corpse fell on the floor, the egg showed no reaction.
One second passed.
Two seconds.
Three seconds.
Then suddenly... a pulse... the red light on the shell shone.
Lian frowned, the next moment something happened that even shocked him.
No mouth opened, no organ appeared, no visible physical change occurred.
But the corpse began to dry up, first the blood disappeared from its body, then the flesh sank, the muscles shrank, the bones cracked, and the entire body withered before his eyes.
In less than a minute, nothing remained but a dry and lifeless shell.
Lian was silent for a few moments.
Then he took out the second corpse, the same thing happened again.
Third.
Fourth.
Fifth.
One after another, all the corpses disappeared in the same way, not really disappeared, but as if all their energy had been drained.
Like a fruit that had its water completely taken out and the fruit itself was eaten too, finally a few dry shells remained on the ground.
Lian whispered quietly.
"What kind of creature is this..." He had seen many monsters.
Fallen ones, even saw an Unholy, treasures and legendary plants in the Celestial Treasury, but none of them were like this.
None of them.
Many questions formed in his mind, if this creature comes out of the egg, what will it look like?
A monster? A legendary creature? Or something completely different? Although his intuition told him that this thing would not only bring no good but could be a nightmare for the world.
At that same moment, the book of treasure reacted and new lines appeared.
[The Devourer of Devourers]
[Growth Progress Updated]
[Current Completion: 1%]
Lian was stunned for a moment, ten corpses and only one percent?

He was not sure if this rate would remain constant or variable and the more it devours, the harder it gets to fill it, but this way, if he wanted to complete this, he would have to stop selling the corpses or cut it in half.
His gaze fixed on the egg again, the red light on its surface had become calmer, as if it had calmed down after eating.
Then for the first time, a new line appeared below the information.
[Feeding Requirement Detected]
[Additional Biomass Recommended]
Lian waited, but before more information appeared, the window faded, as if even the book of treasure still could not analyze the true nature of this creature.
A few seconds of silence ruled the room.
Then he sighed and did not take his gaze off the egg and quietly whispered.
"I feel like I have brought a very big trouble with myself..."
